Job Overview:

The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.

Core Responsibilities:

Student Support & Intervention

  • Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.
  • Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.
  • Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.
  • Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.
  • Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.
  • Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.
  • Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students' plans.
  • Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.
  • Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.
  • Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.
  • Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.
  • Support the development and maintenance of EAC's Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.
  • Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.
  • Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.
  • Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.
  • Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.
  • Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.
  • Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.
  • Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.
  • Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).
  • Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.

Collaboration

  • Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.
  • Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.
  • Monitor students' progress and well-being.
  • Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.
  • Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students' learning.
  • Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.
  • Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.
  • Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.
  • Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.
  • Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.

Operational and Professional Conduct

  • Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.
  • Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.
  • Maintain accurate student records.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities.
  • Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.
  • Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.
  • Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Other duties, as assigned.

Working Conditions:

  • Walk on paths and rough terrain
  • May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Education Required:

BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent

Minimum Experience Required:

  • Five years of teaching experience, preferred
  • Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.
  • Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.

Specific Knowledge:

  • Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.
  • Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.
  • Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC's Teacher Standards.

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.
  • Collegial and collaborative.
  • Innovative and creative.
  • Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.

English level required:

C1 or above

Portuguese level required:

none for teachers instructing in English

C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC's Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Senior Graphic Designer / Brand & Creative Lead
description:
Location requirement: This role is open only to candidates currently based in São Paulo, Brazil.

About Boldr

Boldr is building the future of residential energy management. Our mission is to help homeowners connect and optimize the energy assets in their homes, reducing energy consumption and lowering utility bills. We are starting with the largest residential energy market in the U.S. — HVAC.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced graphic designer with an exceptional creative eye and a strong understanding of branding to help shape how Boldr looks and feels across every customer touchpoint.

This is a hands-on role with ownership of visual creative direction. You'll develop concepts, establish a clear visual approach, and bring that direction to life through branding, email design, packaging, landing pages, websites, marketing campaigns, and sales materials.

We're looking for someone who can take an open-ended brief, bring thoughtful ideas to the table, and turn them into polished, distinctive designs. You should have a strong instinct for typography, layout, color, imagery, and the details that make a brand feel cohesive and recognizable.

You'll work across teams to ensure our creative work communicates clearly, reflects our brand, and supports both customer needs and business goals.

What You'll Do

  • Brand identity and creative direction: Evolve Boldr's visual identity, develop creative concepts and moodboards, and establish a consistent direction across digital and physical materials.
  • Brand guidelines and templates: Build and maintain practical brand guidelines, reusable design assets, and templates that help teams produce consistent work.
  • Email design: Design marketing campaigns, newsletters, product announcements, and customer lifecycle emails with clear hierarchy, strong visual storytelling, and mobile-friendly layouts.
  • Landing pages and websites: Design landing pages, website pages, and product pages in Figma, from initial layouts to polished desktop and mobile designs ready for development.
  • Packaging and print: Design product packaging, labels, inserts, quick-start guides, brochures, and other printed materials, preparing production-ready files and coordinating with suppliers where needed.
  • Campaigns and product launches: Develop visual concepts for launches and campaigns, translating a central idea into cohesive assets across email, web, social, and advertising.
  • Advertising and social creative: Create static ads, carousels, social graphics, and campaign variations that balance brand quality with marketing objectives.
  • Sales and partner materials: Design presentations, product one-pagers, sales collateral, and co-branded materials for channel partners.
  • Product storytelling: Turn technical information and product benefits into clear visuals, diagrams, infographics, and educational content.
  • Art direction: Guide photography, product imagery, illustration, and other creative assets, collaborating with video editors, photographers, and external creatives as needed.
  • Project ownership: Manage projects from brief through final delivery, present your creative rationale, incorporate feedback, and maintain a high standard of quality across multiple priorities.

Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of professional experience in graphic design, brand design, or a related creative role.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent visual judgment and cohesive branding across multiple formats.
  • Proven ability to develop original creative concepts and carry them through to finished work.
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, composition, color, visual hierarchy, and image selection.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
  • Experience designing emails, responsive websites, and landing pages, with an understanding of usability, accessibility, and conversion-focused design.
  • Experience designing packaging and printed materials, including familiarity with dielines, bleeds, color specifications, and print production.
  • Ability to translate complex products or ideas into simple, compelling visual communication.
  • Confidence in making creative decisions, explaining your thinking, and providing constructive design feedback.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and ownership of deadlines.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaborating with stakeholders across different functions.
  • Professional or native-level English proficiency. All communication and content will be in English.

Bonus Skills & Experience

We'd especially like to hear from candidates who also have experience with:

  • Experience within the trades/HVAC industry and marketing to HVAC business and contractors.
  • Consumer technology, connected devices, or physical product brands.
  • Art directing product photography, lifestyle shoots, or 3D renders.
  • Motion graphics and simple animation.
  • Building website pages with product focus
  • Implementing email designs in Klaviyo, HubSpot, or similar tools.
  • Performance marketing creative and using campaign results to improve design.
  • AI-powered creative tools for concept exploration, asset creation, and production workflows, while maintaining originality and quality.

What Success Looks Like

Boldr's brand feels cohesive, distinctive, and thoughtfully designed across our website, emails, packaging, campaigns, and partner materials.

You become a trusted creative partner who can take a business objective, propose a strong visual direction, and deliver excellent work with increasing independence. The systems and templates you create also make it easier for the wider team to maintain that standard as we grow.

Remote Work

This position is remote within São Paulo, Brazil. Candidates must currently be based in São Paulo and be available to attend occasional team activities at our São Paulo office.

You should be comfortable working independently, communicating asynchronously, managing deadlines, and collaborating with team members across different functions.

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your CV or resume.
  • A portfolio link included in your CV or resume.

We're particularly interested in seeing a brand identity carried across several touchpoints, alongside examples of email design, packaging, and websites or landing pages.

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

title: Regulatory Science & Product Registration Lead (Seeds & Traits)
description:
Position Overview

This role leads the technical writing, dossier compilation, and procedural management for genetically modified (GM) crops and gene-edited products (New Breeding Techniques - NBTs) in Brazil. The Lead will combine a process-driven mindset with solid scientific knowledge to draft regulatory submissions, manage Planned Environmental Releases (LPMAs), and author technical responses to CTNBio's official inquiries. Additionally, this position will drive regulatory intelligence and oversee VCU (Value for Cultivation and Use) trials required for variety registration with MAPA.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the preparation, technical writing, and assembly of scientific dossiers for commercial release and Planned Environmental Releases (LPMAs), ensuring full compliance with CTNBio standards.
  • Act as the technical lead for analyzing and drafting precise, science-based responses to official inquiries and data requests from CTNBio members.
  • Leverage a solid background in molecular biology to support regulatory strategies and technical rationales for gene-edited products, addressing official consultations for NBTs.
  • Oversee the planning, data alignment, and administrative requirements for VCU (Valor de Cultivo e Uso) trials, ensuring the bridge between CTNBio biosafety approvals and National Cultivar Registration (RNC) with MAPA.
  • Continuously monitor, analyze, and map changes in the Latin American regulatory landscape, competitive landscape (competitor pipeline), and evolving guidelines.
  • Interface with global R&D teams to translate, adapt, and validate global data into the standard format required by Brazilian authorities.

Qualifications

  • PhD in Biotechnology, Biology or Agronomy, with minimum of 5 years relevant experience; MSc with minimum of 8 years relevant experience with a focus on molecular genetics.
  • Proven experience in technical writing for biotechnology regulatory affairs in Brazil. Demonstrated track record in drafting CTNBio dossiers and handling official inquiries.
  • Deep, process-oriented understanding of CTNBio requirements, with solid experience evaluating complex molecular characterization data. This includes hands-on familiarity with southern blot analysis, next-generation sequencing (NGS), flanking sequences, allergenicity/toxicity profiles, and food/feed/environmental risk assessment data packages.
  • Familiarity with MAPA's administrative and legal frameworks, specifically regarding VCU (Valor de Cultivo e Uso) trial protocols, data alignment, and RNC (Registro Nacional de Cultivares) registration procedures to ensure the smooth transition from biosafety approval to commercial seed licensing.
  • Attention to quality and detail-oriented.
  • Efficient and timeline driven.
  • Excellent oral and written communication (including presentation) skills.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese is required for scientific data review and alignment with global R&D teams.

title: Analista de Departamento Pessoal Sr. - BPO / Implantação ADP
description:
Come Join our Family Today!

Together, We Make Travel Better!

Atuar como especialista de Departamento Pessoal e Payroll no projeto de implantação da ADP como novo sistema de Folha de Pagamento, sendo o principal ponto focal interno para os temas relacionados à legislação trabalhista brasileira, processos de folha, ponto, benefícios, integrações, obrigações legais e reportes financeiros.

Será responsável por garantir que a parametrização, configuração, integrações e processos da ADP estejam adequadamente estruturados e em conformidade com a legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e fiscal brasileira, bem como com as políticas e necessidades de reporte da companhia e do GSC (Global Service Center).

Atuará de forma próxima à ADP e ao atual fornecedor de Payroll, Irko, liderando o levantamento, validação, saneamento e padronização das informações necessárias para a migração e implantação do novo sistema.

Espera-se que seja um profissional hands-on, organizado, analítico, autônomo e orientado a detalhes, capaz de executar e revisar processos operacionais de Payroll com elevado nível de precisão, identificar inconsistências e riscos trabalhistas de forma preventiva e propor melhorias antes que os problemas impactem a folha de pagamento ou os colaboradores.

O que você presisará

1. Liderança técnica da implantação da ADP

  • Atuar como principal ponto focal de Payroll/Departamento Pessoal no projeto de implantação da ADP no Brasil.
  • Liderar tecnicamente a parametrização da ADP, garantindo que as regras de negócio estejam corretamente traduzidas para o sistema.
  • Participar ativamente do desenho, configuração, validação e homologação dos módulos contratados, incluindo Payroll, Time & Attendance/Ponto, Web Report e demais módulos aplicáveis.
  • Garantir que a configuração do sistema reflita corretamente a legislação trabalhista brasileira, regras previdenciárias, fiscais, benefícios, jornadas, adicionais, afastamentos, férias, rescisões e demais processos de Departamento Pessoal.
  • Avaliar impactos de alterações de legislação, políticas internas e regras coletivas na parametrização do sistema.
  • Atuar como SME (Subject Matter Expert) de Payroll nas discussões técnicas com a ADP, GSC, Financeiro, RH e demais stakeholders.
  • Identificar gaps entre os processos atuais e a solução ADP e propor alternativas para padronização, automação e melhoria dos processos.

2. Levantamento e saneamento de dados com a parceira externa

  • Liderar o levantamento de todas as informações, regras, históricos e parametrizações atualmente mantidas pela Irko.
  • Mapear os processos atuais de Payroll, incluindo regras de cálculo, rubricas, jornadas, adicionais, benefícios, descontos, férias, rescisões, afastamentos, encargos e obrigações legais.
  • Garantir a padronização, consistência e qualidade dos dados antes da migração para a ADP.
  • Revisar e validar informações históricas e cadastrais necessárias para a implantação.
  • Identificar inconsistências, duplicidades, informações incompletas ou parametrizações inadequadas no sistema atual.
  • Documentar regras de negócio e particularidades atualmente utilizadas pela Irko, avaliando sua aderência à legislação e sua necessidade de manutenção na nova solução.
  • Garantir que o conhecimento atualmente concentrado no fornecedor seja adequadamente transferido para a empresa e incorporado aos processos e à documentação do novo sistema.

3. Legislação trabalhista e compliance

  • Garantir que todos os processos e parametrizações de Payroll estejam em conformidade com a legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e fiscal brasileira.
  • Manter conhecimento atualizado sobre CLT, eSocial, INSS, FGTS, IRRF, DCTFWeb, EFD-Reinf, eventos trabalhistas e demais obrigações relacionadas à folha de pagamento.
  • Interpretar alterações legais e avaliar seus impactos sobre processos, sistemas e cálculos de Payroll.
  • Garantir a correta aplicação das regras previstas nas diferentes Convenções Coletivas de Trabalho (CCTs) aplicáveis às unidades da empresa.
  • Avaliar diferenças de regras entre unidades, sindicatos e categorias profissionais, garantindo sua correta parametrização na ADP.
  • Identificar preventivamente potenciais riscos trabalhistas, previdenciários ou financeiros.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas a Payroll e obrigações trabalhistas.

4. Testes, homologação e Parallel Run

  • Elaborar e executar planos de testes para todos os processos críticos de Payroll.
  • Realizar testes unitários, integrados e de ponta a ponta dos módulos e integrações.
  • Conduzir parallel run entre a folha atual e a folha processada na ADP durante o período de implantação.
  • Realizar auditoria detalhada dos resultados, identificando diferenças entre a folha atual e a ADP.
  • Investigar divergências, identificar causa-raiz e acompanhar a correção dos problemas junto à ADP.
  • Validar cálculos de salários, horas extras, adicional noturno, DSR, férias, 13o salário, rescisões, encargos, benefícios, descontos e demais eventos.
  • Garantir que todos os cenários críticos estejam testados antes do Go-Live.
  • Documentar evidências dos testes e aprovações para fins de auditoria e governança do projeto.

5. Ponto, jornada e integrações

  • Liderar a implantação e parametrização do módulo de Ponto/Time & Attendance da ADP.
  • Garantir a correta configuração das jornadas, escalas, banco de horas, horas extras, adicional noturno, tolerâncias, intervalos e demais regras aplicáveis.
  • Validar a integração entre sistemas de ponto, Payroll, benefícios e demais sistemas corporativos.
  • Identificar e solucionar inconsistências de interface e integração entre sistemas.
  • Garantir a correta transferência das informações de ponto para processamento da folha.
  • Avaliar impactos das diferentes jornadas e CCTs na parametrização do sistema.

6. Benefícios

  • Garantir a correta integração entre Payroll e sistemas de benefícios.
  • Validar processos de inclusão, exclusão e alteração de benefícios que tenham impacto na folha.
  • Garantir o correto tratamento de benefícios como VT, VA, VR, assistência médica, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida e demais benefícios aplicáveis.
  • Validar descontos de colaboradores, coparticipações, mensalidades e demais valores relacionados aos benefícios.
  • Apoiar a identificação e correção de divergências entre sistemas de benefícios e Payroll.

7. Auditoria e controle de Payroll

  • Realizar auditorias periódicas da folha de pagamento, identificando erros, inconsistências e desvios.
  • Revisar processos e controles existentes, propondo melhorias para aumentar a qualidade, segurança e eficiência do Payroll.
  • Desenvolver e executar controles de pré e pós-folha.
  • Validar variações relevantes de Payroll, headcount e custos.
  • Analisar diferenças entre períodos e investigar desvios relevantes.
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade das alterações realizadas no sistema.
  • Desenvolver controles preventivos para reduzir erros recorrentes e riscos operacionais.

8. Reportes para GSC, Financeiro e Matriz

  • Garantir a preparação e qualidade dos reportes de Payroll e Staff Cost para o GSC e áreas Financeiras.
  • Preparar e/ou validar informações de Payroll para reporte à matriz estrangeira.
  • Garantir a consistência entre Payroll, Headcount, Budget e Forecast.
  • Apoiar os processos de fechamento mensal e reporte financeiro.
  • Preparar análises de variação de custos de pessoal, identificando os principais drivers.
  • Garantir que os reportes atendam aos padrões, prazos e formatos estabelecidos pelo GSC e pela matriz.
  • Atuar como interface entre RH/Payroll, Finance e GSC em assuntos relacionados a custos de pessoal.

9. Gestão de cronograma e governança do projeto

  • Acompanhar integralmente o cronograma de implantação estabelecido contratualmente com a ADP.
  • Monitorar entregas, milestones, dependências, pendências e riscos do projeto.
  • Antecipar potenciais atrasos e atuar preventivamente para garantir o cumprimento dos prazos.
  • Escalar riscos críticos para a liderança sempre que necessário.
  • Acompanhar os compromissos assumidos pela ADP e demais fornecedores envolvidos.
  • Garantir que eventuais atrasos ou falhas de entrega sejam formalmente documentados e tratados.
  • Apoiar a gestão contratual do projeto, inclusive na identificação de impactos decorrentes de atrasos que possam resultar em multas, custos adicionais ou impactos no Go-Live.
  • Participar de reuniões de status, steering committees e fóruns de governança do projeto.

10. Processos de Departamento Pessoal

  • Admissão e cadastro de colaboradores;
  • Folha de pagamento;
  • Férias;
  • 13o salário;
  • Rescisões;
  • Afastamentos;
  • Benefícios;
  • Controle de ponto e jornada;
  • Horas extras;
  • Adicional noturno;
  • Encargos trabalhistas e previdenciários;
  • eSocial;
  • Obrigações acessórias;
  • Cálculos e conferências de Payroll;
  • Processos relacionados às CCTs;
  • Auditorias e controles de folha.

O que você precisará

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade, Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação/MBA em Gestão de Pessoas, Departamento Pessoal, Payroll, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas relacionadas será considerado diferencial.
  • Experiência sólida em Departamento Pessoal/Payroll, preferencialmente em empresas de médio ou grande porte.
  • Experiência comprovada em auditoria e conferência de folha de pagamento.
  • Experiência em projetos de implantação, migração ou troca de sistemas de Payroll.
  • Experiência com implantação da ADP será um diferencial importante.
  • Experiência com eSocial e obrigações relacionadas ao Payroll.
  • Experiência com integração entre sistemas de Ponto, Folha e Benefícios.
  • Experiência trabalhando com múltiplas unidades, diferentes operações e diferentes Convenções Coletivas de Trabalho (CCTs).
  • Experiência com processos de Payroll envolvendo reporte para matriz ou estruturas internacionais.
  • Experiência com análise e reporte de Staff Cost.
  • Experiência em projetos com fornecedores externos/BPO será considerada diferencial.

title: Promotor técnico

description:
locations

Brazil - Homebased

We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!

Job Title: LATAM Training Coordinator

Location: Remote – Brazil | Rare travel required

As the LATAM Training Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of BSI's Assurance Training programs across Brazil and LATAM. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who enjoys coordinating people, managing logistics, solving problems, and creating a great customer experience.

You'll coordinate both virtual and in-person training programs from scheduling through post-training follow-up, working closely with instructors, learners, clients, Sales, and internal teams. You'll also help ensure our training systems and records are accurate, our sessions run smoothly, and our learners receive the support they need.

We're looking for someone who is organized, responsive, customer-focused, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. If you enjoy bringing structure to complex activities and making sure the details are taken care of, this could be a great opportunity for you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the scheduling and delivery of virtual, public, and in-house training programs.
  • Manage training logistics, including venues, catering, room setup, technology, materials, and instructor requirements.
  • Maintain accurate course, learner, and instructor information in the Learning Management System (LMS).
  • Work closely with instructors, Sales, clients, and internal teams to ensure training sessions are fully prepared and delivered successfully.
  • Support learners and instructors with questions regarding course access, certificates, payments, scheduling, and logistics.
  • Monitor enrollments, cancellations, rescheduling, attendance, and course capacity.
  • Provide basic technical support during virtual training sessions and escalate issues when needed.
  • Maintain accurate training records and support reporting on training activity, learner feedback, and performance.
  • Support administrative and financial activities, including purchase orders, invoices, vendor coordination, and internal tracking.
  • Identify opportunities to improve training processes, systems, and the overall customer experience.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • 2–4 years of experience in training coordination, program administration, event coordination, or customer service, preferably within a corporate or professional services environment.
  • Experience coordinating both virtual and in-person training or events.
  • Experience working with a Learning Management System (LMS) such as Docebo or a similar platform.
  • Experience using CRM systems such as Salesforce for data entry, lead management, or recordkeeping.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a strong customer service mindset.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and remain calm and solution-oriented in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word, and experience with virtual platforms such as Microsoft Teams.
  • A bachelor's degree in Education, Business Administration, Human Resources, Project/Event Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, both written and verbal, is required. Spanish would be an advantage.

If you're someone who enjoys keeping things organized, supporting customers, and making sure every detail comes together, we'd love to hear from you.

What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working, ongoing training and development, and a wide range of benefits designed to support your wellbeing and lifestyle.

Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company, helping organizations become more sustainable and resilient while inspiring trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization, with more than 100 years of experience. We work with organizations around the world, providing standards, auditing, certification, training, consulting, and innovative solutions across a wide range of industries.

Through our unique combination of expertise, training, assurance, and regulatory services, we help organizations build resilience, improve performance, and create trust.

If you want to contribute to this inspiring challenge and bring your organized, collaborative, and customer-focused mindset to our dynamic team, apply now!

D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

#LI-REMOTE

#LI-MH1

About Us

BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.

Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.

Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.

Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society's critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.

BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

title: Coordenador de Meio Ambiente
description:
A Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo, com um portfólio icônico de marcas de fragrâncias, cosméticos, cuidados com a pele e cuidados com o corpo. Na Coty, celebramos e cultivamos uma cultura de gentileza. Acreditamos que a beleza reside na diversidade e estamos empenhados em continuar a construir um ambiente onde todos os talentos brilham, pois valorizamos as contribuições únicas que cada indivíduo traz para a nossa equipe. E como parte do nosso compromisso com a inclusão, todos os perfis são bem-vindos.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Coordenar a gestão ambiental da unidade, assegurando a operação adequada dos sistemas de tratamento de água e efluentes, a gestão de resíduos sólidos e o atendimento aos requisitos legais, corporativos e demais requisitos aplicáveis;
  • Implementar, manter e desenvolver o Sistema de Gestão Ambiental da fábrica, garantindo o cumprimento e a disseminação da Política Ambiental corporativa, dos procedimentos internos e das diretrizes de sustentabilidade;
  • Garantir a eficiência operacional, a conformidade ambiental e a melhoria contínua dos processos sob sua responsabilidade, atuando na prevenção de impactos ambientais, na redução de perdas e na gestão responsável dos recursos naturais.
  • Garantir os requisitos de Saúde e Segurança, assegurando o cumprimento das ferramentas de HSE, a prevenção de riscos, a participação em programas, auditorias e rotinas de segurança e o desdobramento das diretrizes para a equipe;
  • Gerir a equipe de Meio Ambiente, incluindo jornada, férias, capacitação, integração, comunicação, feedbacks, avaliação de desempenho, desenvolvimento e engajamento;
  • Conduzir a gestão e a rotina da área, assegurando padronização, cumprimento de procedimentos, registros, 5S, metas, KPIs, planos de ação, auditorias, análises críticas e tratamento de desvios e não conformidades;
  • Garantir a operação da ETA e ETE, assegurando desempenho e conformidade dos sistemas de tratamento de água e efluentes, com acompanhamento dos parâmetros legais e operacionais, eficiência, consumo de químicos, geração de lodo e qualidade dos processos;
  • Assegurar a manutenção e confiabilidade dos ativos ambientais, garantindo registro e tratamento de anomalias, acompanhamento das manutenções preventivas e corretivas junto à Manutenção, Utilidades e Engenharia e desenvolvimento de melhorias técnicas e projetos;
  • Gerir os processos de resíduos, assegurando segregação, armazenamento, movimentação, transporte, destinação e rastreabilidade, incluindo gestão de prestadores e atendimento aos requisitos legais;
  • Administrar custos e orçamento da área, elaborando e acompanhando o orçamento, controlando custos de ETA, ETE, resíduos, monitoramentos, serviços e insumos, além de gerir compras, contratos, estoques e oportunidades de redução de custos;
  • Assegurar os requisitos de Qualidade aplicáveis à área, incluindo BPF, gestão de reagentes, calibração e manutenção de instrumentos, cumprimento dos planos analíticos, análise de resultados e tratamento de desvios;
  • Manter e desenvolver o Sistema de Gestão Ambiental, abrangendo aspectos e impactos, controles operacionais, procedimentos, monitoramentos e indicadores de desempenho ambiental;
  • Assegurar a conformidade legal ambiental, garantindo identificação e atendimento da legislação, gestão de licenças, autorizações, condicionantes e obrigações, incluindo reportes aos órgãos competentes;
  • Planejar e acompanhar os monitoramentos ambientais, garantindo execução e análise dos controles de águas, efluentes, resíduos, emissões, ruído e demais aspectos aplicáveis, em conformidade com requisitos legais e internos;
  • Promover comunicação e capacitação ambiental, por meio de treinamentos, campanhas, orientações e ações de conscientização para colaboradores e terceiros;
  • Garantir a gestão documental ambiental, assegurando controle, atualização, rastreabilidade e disponibilidade de registros, licenças, certificados, laudos, relatórios, manifestos e demais documentos ambientais;
  • Assegurar a preparação e resposta a emergências ambientais, mantendo planos, cenários, recursos, procedimentos, treinamentos e simulados para vazamentos, derramamentos e demais ocorrências;
  • Promover melhoria contínua e sustentabilidade, implementando projetos para redução do consumo de água, energia, químicos e recursos naturais, redução de resíduos e efluentes, aumento da reutilização e reciclagem e melhoria da eficiência ambiental.

title: Impulsiona CTC - Banco de talentos Programa de estágio

title: Assessor de Investimentos
description:
Assessor(a) de Investimentos – Suporte a Bankers e Carteiras - RGC Invest | XP

Buscamos um profissional para atuar na área de Suporte a Investimentos da RGC Invest, apoiando os sócios e bankers do escritório na gestão e no acompanhamento das carteiras de seus clientes.

A posição combina atividades operacionais, relacionamento com clientes e apoio na análise e implementação de soluções de investimento. É uma excelente oportunidade para quem deseja desenvolver carreira no mercado financeiro, aprofundar seus conhecimentos sobre investimentos e trabalhar próximo a profissionais experientes e clientes de diferentes perfis.

Principais responsabilidades

Como integrante da área de Suporte a Investimentos, você será responsável por:

  • Apoiar os processos de abertura, atualização e manutenção de contas de investidores Pessoa Física e Pessoa Jurídica vinculados à RGC Invest | XP;
  • Atender e apoiar clientes PF e PJ em suas demandas operacionais junto à XP e às instituições parceiras da RGC Invest;
  • Acompanhar as solicitações dos clientes até sua efetiva resolução, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e boa experiência no atendimento;
  • Apoiar a implantação e o acompanhamento das soluções de investimento recomendadas pelos bankers, pela XP ou pelos especialistas da RGC Invest;
  • Auxiliar sócios e bankers na preparação de relatórios, análises de carteira e apresentações de resultados e de novas soluções de investimento;
  • Acompanhar movimentações e soluções implantadas, identificando necessidades de ajustes e apoiando sua operacionalização;
  • Contribuir para a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de atendimento e acompanhamento das carteiras;
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões e eventos presenciais e on-line relacionados ao mercado financeiro, ampliando continuamente seus conhecimentos sobre produtos, investimentos e soluções para clientes.

Perfil que buscamos

Procuramos uma pessoa organizada, proativa, responsável e interessada em desenvolver carreira no mercado financeiro.

São importantes:

  • Boa capacidade de raciocínio lógico e análise, tanto quantitativa quanto qualitativa;
  • Facilidade com números e conhecimentos ou interesse em matemática financeira;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Facilidade de relacionamento com clientes e com a equipe interna;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Capacidade de acompanhar diferentes demandas simultaneamente e garantir sua conclusão;
  • Interesse genuíno pelo mercado financeiro, investimentos e gestão de patrimônio;
  • Disposição para aprender e se desenvolver continuamente.

Certificação profissional

Para o exercício da função será necessária a certificação profissional exigida para atuação como Assessor de Investimentos, por meio da ANCORD.

Caso você ainda não possua a certificação, isso não será um impedimento para participar do processo seletivo. A RGC Invest apoiará sua preparação para a obtenção da certificação, que representa uma importante qualificação profissional para quem deseja construir carreira no mercado de investimentos.

Modelo de remuneração

Esta oportunidade não possui vínculo de contratação pelo regime CLT.

O modelo de remuneração é composto por:

  • Ajuda de custo; e
  • Remuneração variável/comissionada, vinculada às atividades e aos resultados da função.

Sobre a oportunidade

Mais do que executar atividades operacionais, o profissional terá contato direto com a rotina de um escritório de investimentos, participando do acompanhamento de carteiras, relacionamento com clientes e implementação de soluções financeiras.

  • É uma posição indicada especialmente para quem busca iniciar ou acelerar sua carreira no mercado financeiro, adquirindo conhecimento prático e desenvolvendo-se para assumir responsabilidades cada vez maiores dentro da atividade de investimentos.

title: Coordenador de Remuneração

title: Pesquisador Doutor - Markal - Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em soluções de pulverização - Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Você deseja atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções voltadas à pulverização agrícola e contribuir para a evolução de produtos e componentes com alto impacto no campo? Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para quem busca aplicar conhecimento avançado em engenharia de produto, detalhamento técnico e desenvolvimento aplicado, apoiando a MARKAL na criação e aprimoramento de projetos voltados ao desempenho, confiabilidade e eficiência operacional em aplicações agrícolas. O projeto envolve o desenvolvimento e detalhamento de produtos e componentes, além da estruturação de documentação técnica e materiais que assegurem padronização e suporte à aplicação em campo.

Buscamos um profissional com visão sistêmica, capacidade analítica e forte domínio técnico para transformar requisitos em soluções viáveis, conduzir detalhamentos de projeto com precisão e garantir a qualidade da entrega por meio da elaboração de manuais técnicos e padronizações. Também será essencial apoiar a capacitação da equipe técnica, fortalecendo a transferência de conhecimento e a consolidação de boas práticas de engenharia. Se você tem afinidade com desenvolvimento de produto, documentação técnica e inovação aplicada ao agronegócio, esta oportunidade é para você.

Doutorado completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas;

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em soluções de pulverização.

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções para pulverização agrícola
  • Modelagem e prototipagem 3D em SolidWorks
  • Acompanhamento de projetos do início ao fim, incluindo implantação fabril
  • Desenvolvimento de melhorias para produtos já existentes

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Domínio de SolidWorks para modelagem e detalhamento 2D e 3D;
  • Capacidade de desenvolver montagens mecânicas de alta complexidade;
  • Experiência com cálculos estruturais e análise do funcionamento de sistemas mecânicos;

  • Conhecimento de normas ABNT e Normas Regulamentadoras aplicáveis à engenharia;
  • Atenção aos requisitos de segurança de máquinas e aos critérios técnicos de projeto.

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e validação de protótipos;

title: Senior Project Manager (Marketing Agency)
description:
Overview

Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency with a growing (20+) distributed team across the U.S., Canada, Europe and Latin America. We provide beginning-to-end strategy, design and production services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

We're looking for a Project Manager to run two kinds of work: ongoing marketing retainers (content, SEO, paid, email, social) and project accounts for brand strategy, design and website builds. Working with our account leads and Marketing Strategist, you'll be the client's operational day-to-day contact and the person who makes sure the right thing ships on the right day at the right quality, every time. A Marketing Strategist sets the direction on retainers; you turn it into a plan that holds.

This role rewards people who notice what everyone else misses: the date that doesn't match, the version that isn't the latest, tickets out of date, the deliverable that's technically done but not actually ready. If that describes you, and you've run marketing projects at an agency before, keep reading.

You're also AI-forward without being AI-dazzled. We use AI across delivery: drafting recaps, summarizing calls, building status reports, checking work. You'll be the review gate. AI drafts, you decide, and nothing reaches a client without a human who has actually read it. You'll report to the Account Director and COO and work alongside our strategy, design, and development teams.

Key Responsibilities

Client management

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day operational contact for 5-6 retainer clients and 4+ active project accounts at any time
  • Run the client cadence: kickoffs, weekly or biweekly check-ins, monthly reviews (with the Marketing Strategist leading the marketing content), and project milestones
  • Manage scope, change requests, retainer hours, and expectations; flag risks before they become surprises
  • Prepare and send clear written updates, recaps and next steps after every client touchpoint
  • Report on outcomes, not just activity: did the retainer deliver what the quarterly plan promised, not only whether the hours were spent

Project management

  • Build and own project plans, timelines, and resourcing in Monday.com for retainers and for brand, design and website projects
  • Coordinate designers, writers, developers and freelancers across time zones; keep everyone unblocked and on schedule
  • Track hours against retainer allocations and project budgets weekly; report variances early
  • Run internal reviews and QA every deliverable for accuracy, completeness and consistency before it reaches the client: links, dates, naming, versions, specs, copy
  • Maintain clean documentation: briefs, decisions, approvals, asset locations

AI-enabled delivery and systems

  • Use AI tools daily to draft recaps, summarize calls, prepare status reports and check deliverables, and own the review gate: every AI-assisted output gets a human read and approval before it goes anywhere
  • Know the failure modes (invented facts, stale data, weak prompts, missing context) and catch them before the client does
  • Set clear boundaries on what AI touches on each account and what stays fully human, and be transparent with clients about how we use it

Key KPIs

  • On-time delivery: 95%+ of milestones and deliverables shipped on the committed date
  • Operational efficiency: deviation from retainer hour allocations and project budgets under 10%
  • Client Satisfaction (CSAT): average score 4.7+
  • Client retention: renewal of assigned retainers and repeat project work
  • Internal quality score: average score 4.7+ from the delivery team on clarity of plans and briefs
  • Zero-defect delivery: client-reported errors in shipped work trending to zero
  • Plan-to-outcome: every retainer reported against its quarterly plan, not just its hours

Requirements

  • 5+ years in account or project management at a marketing, digital or creative agency, including at least 2 years running marketing retainers (content, paid, email or social) alongside project work
  • Experience managing website builds (Webflow or WordPress) and brand or design projects from brief through launch
  • Exceptional attention to detail: you catch inconsistencies others miss, and you check before you send
  • Hands-on daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Monday.com AI, meeting summarizers or equivalent) to speed up planning, documentation and reporting, and the habit of adapting as the tools change
  • Proven ability to critically evaluate AI output for accuracy, completeness and fit before anything is sent; you treat a draft as a draft
  • Strong writer: clear, concise client communication in English, with fluent spoken English for leading calls
  • Experience with Monday.com or a comparable work management tool; experience building automations is a plus
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote team via Slack, video calls, and Monday.com
  • Based in Brazil, with availability for at least 4 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Figma and Webflow
  • PMP, Scrum or similar certification (useful, not required)

Engagement and Compensation

  • This role is based in Brazil. It's a full-time independent contractor (PJ) engagement, paid in U.S. dollars: US$3,000 to US$4,000 a month, depending on experience.

The Perks

  • Diverse team based in the U.S., U.K., Europe, Canada and Latin America
  • Interesting clients in the technology space, and real ownership of how the work gets delivered
  • Fully remote

  • Manage the onboarding of new team members and ensure smooth integration into the company and client teams.
  • Support engineers during their first months on the project and monitor their adaptation and performance.
  • Manage the offboarding process and coordinate communication with internal teams and client stakeholders when required.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Manage the recruitment process for new engineers in cooperation with the Recruitment team.
  • Clarify position requirements, seniority, technical expectations, and team needs.
  • Participate in candidate evaluation and final hiring decisions.
  • Monitor staffing progress and proactively address hiring challenges.
  • Support workforce planning and identify future staffing needs.

Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders.
  • Understand client expectations, priorities, concerns, and business needs.
  • Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and provide visibility into team performance, staffing, risks, and delivery-related topics.
  • Manage client expectations and proactively address potential issues.
  • Handle difficult conversations and conflicts between the client, engineers, and the company.
  • Represent the company's interests while maintaining a strong and trusted relationship with the client.
  • Escalate risks and critical issues appropriately and work with both sides toward mutually acceptable solutions.

Business Development & Account Growth

  • Understand the client's organization, business objectives, and future plans.
  • Identify opportunities to expand cooperation with existing clients.
  • Recognize potential needs for additional engineers, teams, or services and communicate opportunities internally.
  • Participate in discussions related to new roles, team extensions, and new areas of cooperation.
  • Build relationships with additional stakeholders within the client organization.
  • Support account growth by maintaining high client satisfaction and identifying opportunities for further partnership.
  • Work closely with Delivery, Sales, Recruitment, and other internal teams on account development.

Operational Management

  • Monitor team allocation, staffing changes, performance risks, and retention risks.
  • Coordinate internal processes related to employees working on client accounts.
  • Ensure important information is communicated between the client, engineers, and internal company stakeholders.
  • Identify operational risks and proactively propose solutions.
  • Support planning related to team structure, replacements, transfers, and future growth.

Skills & Experience Required

Management Experience

  • Experience managing software engineering teams.
  • Strong people-management and coaching skills.
  • Experience conducting 1:1s, performance reviews, development discussions, and difficult conversations.
  • Ability to identify performance and motivation issues and take appropriate action.
  • Strong conflict-management and problem-solving skills.

Outsourcing / IT Services Experience

  • Previous experience working in an IT outsourcing, consulting, nearshore, or software services company is highly preferred.
  • Understanding of the relationship between the client, outsourcing company, and engineers assigned to the client project.
  • Experience balancing client expectations with company and employee interests.
  • Understanding of common outsourcing challenges, including staffing, retention, performance management, replacements, rate discussions, and client satisfaction.
  • Ability to act as a trusted intermediary when disagreements or conflicts arise between the client and the company.

Stakeholder Management

  • Strong stakeholder-management and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with international clients and distributed teams.
  • Ability to manage expectations, negotiate priorities, and handle sensitive situations professionally.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills.

Business Development

  • Commercial mindset and interest in developing existing client accounts.
  • Ability to recognize new business and team-growth opportunities.
  • Ability to understand client business needs beyond the immediate engineering scope.
  • Experience participating in account-growth, staffing, or client-development discussions is preferred.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships that can lead to long-term cooperation and account expansion.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Understanding of the software engineering recruitment process.
  • Ability to define hiring needs together with technical and client stakeholders.
  • Experience interviewing or evaluating candidates is preferred.
  • Understanding of the Brazilian engineering talent market is an advantage.

Communication & Personal Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong ownership and proactive mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to manage several people-related, client-related, and operational topics simultaneously.
  • High emotional intelligence and ability to work effectively in challenging or sensitive situations.
  • Ability to communicate bad news, risks, or disagreements clearly and constructively.

Language & International Environment

  • Strong professional English is required for communication with international clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience working in multicultural and distributed environments is preferred.

title: Gerente Contábil e Fiscal
description:
Sobre nós

Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.

Como é atuar conosco

Por meio da nossa área de Alocação de Talentos, você poderá colocar sua experiência em prática em contextos empresariais variados, contribuindo com nosso padrão de excelência em distintas operações e segmentos.

Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E, você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Interface e Processos

Conhecimentos Técnicos

Diferenciais

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.

Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you'll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.

Position Overview

We're looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.

What You'll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.

Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.

Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Gerente de Valuation
description:

Sobre Nós

Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.

Sobre a área

A área de Valuation é fundamental para a análise e a verificação minuciosa de informações, com o objetivo de assegurar a tomada de decisões informadas em processos de transações comerciais, fusões, aquisições e outras movimentações estratégicas.

  • Elaborar e aprovar propostas comerciais, negociar alterações de escopo e apoiar a expansão e o posicionamento da prática de Valuation.
  • Desenvolver parcerias e fontes de dados, assegurando a governança de acessos e informações.

Requisitos e Qualificações

title: Gerente de Projetos - Infraestrutura Viária
description:

description:

No time de Atendimento, você fará parte de uma operação em momento estratégico de transformação e crescimento, com papel central na evolução da experiência dos clientes. No dia a dia você irá:

  • Mediar conflitos entre a equipe e os clientes, buscando soluções que satisfaçam ambas as partes. Lidar com reclamações de forma proativa e eficaz;
  • Manter uma comunicação clara e aberta entre a equipe de atendimento e outras áreas da empresa. Informar a equipe sobre atualizações, políticas e procedimentos relevantes.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia com liderança em operações de atendimento de alta volumetria

  • Forte organização, gestão de tempo e habilidade de priorização
  • Perfil adaptável a ambientes dinâmicos
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar problemas e estruturar soluções eficientes
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de articulação com diferentes stakeholders

title: Especialista de Inteligência de Negócios | Inteligência Comercial
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A. está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de Inteligência Comercial é responsável por transformar dados e informações de mercado em insights estratégicos para apoiar a tomada de decisão e impulsionar os resultados do negócio. Atua de forma integrada às áreas comerciais e executivas, acompanhando indicadores, tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento, contribuindo para decisões mais assertivas e orientadas por dados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Desenvolver análises estratégicas para apoiar decisões comerciais e executivas.
  • Monitorar o mercado, a concorrência e as tendências de negócio, identificando oportunidades e riscos.
  • Construir, evoluir e manter dashboards e indicadores em Looker.
  • Definir, acompanhar e analisar KPIs estratégicos e comerciais.
  • Realizar estudos de mercado e análises competitivas para identificar oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Traduzir desafios de negócio em análises estruturadas e recomendações acionáveis.
  • Desenvolver consultas em SQL para extração, tratamento e análise de dados.
  • Automatizar relatórios e processos analíticos recorrentes, promovendo eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Apresentar insights e recomendações de forma clara para diferentes públicos, incluindo lideranças e áreas parceiras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas estratégicas por meio de análises orientadas a dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Experiência avançada com Looker para criação de dashboards, métricas e visualizações.
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de dados e definição de métricas de negócio.
  • Vivência em análise exploratória e interpretação de dados para geração de insights.
  • Experiência na construção, acompanhamento e gestão de indicadores e KPIs comerciais.
  • Capacidade de comunicar análises de forma clara, utilizando storytelling com dados.
  • Conhecimento de estatística aplicada ao ambiente de negócios.
  • Experiência em áreas de Inteligência de Mercado, Business Intelligence (BI), Analytics ou Planejamento Comercial.
  • Domínio de Excel em nível avançado.
  • Capacidade de transformar dados e análises em recomendações estratégicas para o negócio.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em SQL para consultas e análises em diferentes bases de dados.

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento em Python para automação de processos e análises de dados.
  • Experiência com BigQuery e ferramentas do ecossistema Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Conhecimento em LookML para modelagem e governança de dados no Looker.
  • Vivência com previsão de demanda, forecasting ou modelos preditivos.
  • Experiência em Inteligência Competitiva e avaliação de mercado.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias comerciais e análise de performance de negócios.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro (RJ), bairro da Saúde.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.400 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é amar resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

  • Executar serviços técnicos de manutenção de sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos e elétricos, envolvendo equipamentos de Deck Machinery, principalmente guinchos e guindastes;

title: Mainframe Solution Architect - Remote
description:
About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Role Purpose

Provide end-to-end technical leadership for enterprise solutions on the mainframe platform: translating business and non-functional requirements into scalable, secure and resilient architectures, and guiding engineering teams through implementation, modernization and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Design
  • Own high-level and detailed architecture for complex mainframe applications, APIs, integrations and modernization initiatives.
  • Convert functional and non-functional requirements into blueprints, component designs, interface contracts and implementation guidance.
  • Select appropriate architecture patterns and assess trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, cost and maintainability.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise standards, approved platforms, reusable patterns and target-state roadmaps.
  • Technical Leadership & Governance
  • Give hands-on architectural direction to development, QA, DevOps, security and support teams.
  • Set coding, API, integration, logging, configuration, testing and deployment standards.
  • Run architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, technical risk assessments and PoC evaluations. Security, Reliability & Performance
  • Embed secure-by-design across identity, authorization, secrets, data protection and interface security.
  • Define resiliency patterns — retry, timeout, failover, HA and DR — plus performance and capacity targets.
  • Ensure observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards and alerting.

Technology Focus — Mainframe

  • Design, develop and support COBOL/CICS/DB2 batch and online components within agreed standards.
  • Optimize batch windows, DB2 access paths and resource consumption to protect service levels.
  • Support mainframe modernization, API exposure and integration with distributed and cloud platforms.

Required Technical Competencies

  • COBOL, JCL, CICS, VSAM, DB2 and z/OS utilities; batch and online program design and optimization.
  • Mainframe application architecture, modularization, API enablement and modernization/coexistence patterns.
  • Data & Integration DB2 and VSAM data design, SQL tuning, file handling, data conversion, integrity and reconciliation.
  • Platform & DevOps z/OS operations, scheduling, change management, environment promotion and mainframe-to-distributed integration.
  • Quality & Operations Unit and regression testing, batch cycle validation, performance and MIPS optimization, defect RCA.

title: Mars Program — MBA Leadership
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international brand of Meituan, the world's leading food delivery platform. Guided by the mission of "helping people eat better and live better," we bring 15 years of Meituan's technology and operational expertise to global markets. Since launching in 2023, we have grown from Hong Kong to the Middle East and Brazil — building real value for users, merchants, and delivery partners in every community we serve.

About Mars Program

Mars Program is Keeta's flagship leadership accelerator — a strategic investment in the next generation of business leaders for Brazil. This is not a traditional hire. We are looking for high-potential talents who want to build a long-term career in Brazil, understand the food delivery business end-to-end, and grow into future leaders of this organization.

You will be assigned to one of the four core pillars of our business — Merchant, Consumer, Delivery, and Business Analytics — gaining a comprehensive, hands-on understanding of what it takes to build and scale a world-class food delivery platform.

What You'll Do

Your responsibilities will evolve across business areas, and may include:

  • Drive merchant acquisition, activation, and retention strategies to grow Keeta's supply-side ecosystem in Brazil.
  • Design and execute consumer growth and retention initiatives, tailoring strategies to local user behavior and market dynamics.
  • Optimize delivery operations — improving efficiency, rider experience, and fulfillment quality in the Brazilian market.
  • Conduct business analysis to translate data into strategic insights, supporting key decisions across functions.
  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects, collaborating with local and global teams to solve real business challenges.

What We're Looking For

  • Education: Full-time international MBA required. We seek candidates who have completed or are completing a full-time MBA program, bringing a global perspective and the academic foundation to lead in a complex, fast-growing market.
  • Background: Experience in consulting, finance, tech, fast-moving consumer goods, or management trainee programs is a strong fit. Candidates from outside the industry with demonstrated high potential are equally welcome.
  • Language: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Mindset: Humble, hands-on, curious, resilient — excited by the ambiguity of building something from scratch, not just managing what's already there.

Why Join Mars Program

  • High Starting Point — a dual recognition of your past achievements and future potential. This is our commitment to attracting top talent.
  • End-to-End Business Exposure — specialize in one of our four core pillars. Build the holistic view and foundational logic of the food delivery business that most professionals spend a decade trying to piece together.
  • Executive Mentorship & Visibility — Enter a high-visibility talent pool with direct access to senior leadership, intensive coaching, and exposure to real strategic decisions.
  • World-Class Methodology — Benefit from Meituan's 15 years of deep industry know-how and scientific operating frameworks, now being applied to crack one of the world's most exciting new markets.

Work Location: São Paulo, Brazil.

Onboarding Target: September 2026

Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (PwD). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.
