title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
Assessor(a) de Investimentos | Performance Invest

Sobre a Performance Invest

A Performance Invest é uma assessoria de investimentos voltada a pessoas físicas e jurídicas, com atuação baseada em relacionamento próximo, estratégia e visão de longo prazo.

Unimos a experiência de profissionais com sólida trajetória no mercado financeiro à estrutura e tecnologia da XP Investimentos, oferecendo soluções personalizadas para diferentes momentos e objetivos patrimoniais.

Estamos ampliando nosso time e buscamos Assessores de Investimentos que já atuam no mercado e desejam encontrar uma estrutura que valorize sua autonomia, relacionamento com os clientes e potencial de crescimento.

Sobre a oportunidade

O profissional será responsável pela gestão do relacionamento e desenvolvimento de sua carteira de clientes, identificando necessidades, objetivos e perfil de cada cliente para apoiá-lo na tomada de decisões de investimento, sempre dentro das atribuições aplicáveis ao Assessor de Investimentos.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gestão do relacionamento e desenvolvimento da carteira de clientes;
  • Prospecção e expansão da base de relacionamento;
  • Identificação do perfil, objetivos e necessidades patrimoniais dos clientes;
  • Apoio na construção e acompanhamento de carteiras de investimentos, observados o perfil e os objetivos do cliente e as atribuições regulatórias do Assessor de Investimentos;
  • Acompanhamento de mercado, produtos e oportunidades de investimento;
  • Relacionamento próximo e consultivo com os clientes;
  • Acompanhamento periódico das carteiras e das necessidades dos clientes;
  • Atuação em conformidade com as normas e regulamentações aplicáveis ao mercado financeiro.

Requisitos

  • Certificação ANCORD e credenciamento regular para atuação como Assessor(a) de Investimentos;
  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência como Assessor(a) de Investimentos;
  • Possuir carteira ativa de clientes, independentemente do tamanho;
  • Experiência com relacionamento, atendimento e prospecção de clientes;
  • Conhecimento de produtos financeiros, investimentos, alocação de ativos e relação entre risco e retorno;
  • Perfil comercial e capacidade de prospecção e desenvolvimento de relacionamento;
  • Postura ética, autonomia e visão de longo prazo.

Por que fazer parte da Performance Invest?

Acreditamos que, para entregar uma experiência de excelência aos clientes, o assessor também precisa encontrar um ambiente que valorize seu trabalho e seu desenvolvimento.

Por isso, na Performance Invest, o assessor também é tratado como cliente, contando com uma estrutura pensada para proporcionar autonomia, flexibilidade e condições competitivas para crescer.

Nossos diferenciais:

  • Modelo de trabalho flexível: 100% remoto ou híbrido, de acordo com a preferência do assessor;
  • Flexibilidade de horários;
  • Estrutura e suporte para desenvolvimento da carteira;
  • Autonomia e relacionamento próximo com o escritório;
  • Acesso ao ecossistema e às soluções da XP Investimentos.

Se você já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos e procura uma estrutura para desenvolver sua carteira com mais autonomia, flexibilidade e condições competitivas, queremos conhecer você.

title: Atendente de Call Center - Chat e Libras
description:

title: Inside Sales & Customer Growth Manager
description:
Location: São Paulo - SP. (Regional scope)

Reports to: Regional Director Brazil & Colombia

Team: Directly manages analysts/executors across four functions (no intermediate leads at this stage), 10 HCs

About the Role

We are looking for a Head Manager of Inside Sales & Customer Growth to lead and structure our Inside Sales operation. This position comes with a clear mission: to become the engine of scalable, replicable, and intelligent customer base growth.

This role currently oversees four distinct functions — inbound lead conversion (hunting), churn account reactivation, remote servicing of small accounts, and sales support — with direct management of each team member.

Mission

Drive scalable, replicable, and intelligent growth of the customer base across the region by directly managing and standardizing the operations of lead conversion, account reactivation, remote account servicing, and commercial support — freeing up the Key Account Management (KAM) team to focus on strategic accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Hunting (Inbound Lead Conversion)

  • Own the process for receiving and converting leads generated through the portal
  • Drive speed-to-lead and improve conversion rate through process discipline and coaching
  • Define and monitor SLAs for response time and follow-up

Churn Reactivation

  • Lead efforts to reactivate churned accounts and recover lost revenue
  • Build a systematic, repeatable approach to identifying and prioritizing reactivation opportunities

Small Accounts (Remote Servicing)

  • Manage remote coverage of small accounts that do not warrant a dedicated KAM
  • Ensure service quality and account growth through efficient, scalable processes

Sales Support

  • Provide operational support to the broader commercial team
  • Ensure fast turnaround and high satisfaction from internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Design and standardize playbooks and processes across all four functions, built to be replicable across countries (Brazil & Colombia)
  • Directly manage, coach, and develop the individuals executing each function
  • Track and report on performance metrics across all four workstreams
  • Partner closely with Marketing, KAMs, Customer Success, and the broader Commercial team to align on lead flow, account handoffs, and shared goals

Success Metrics (6–12 months)

  • Growth in active customer base (%)
  • Standardized, documented processes across all four functions, replicable across countries
  • Improved conversion rate (hunting) and reactivation rate (churn)
  • Team development plan in place, with a clear path toward a squad-lead structure as the operation scales

What We're Looking For

Industry Experience

  • Solid experience in the travel & tourism industry, ideally within online travel platforms (OTAs), booking marketplaces, or tour/travel operators
  • Understanding of how travel distribution works — lead sources, booking cycles, seasonality, and the relationship dynamics between platforms, operators, and agents

Functional / Technical

  • Strong analytical capability — comfortable reading funnel data, conversion metrics, and churn/cohort analysis
  • Process-oriented mindset, with experience designing or improving operational playbooks

Leadership

  • People management experience, ideally across diverse functions or a fast-changing environment
  • Execution discipline — able to drive rhythm, accountability, and results
  • Strong negotiation and cross-functional influence skills — this role depends heavily on alignment with Marketing, KAMs, Customer Success, and Sales

Behavioral

  • Builder mindset — comfortable structuring a function from the ground up in a lean, still-forming regional operation
  • Autonomy and comfort with ambiguity
  • Cultural adaptability, with an eye toward managing teams across multiple countries as the role expands

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Customer Growth roles
  • Experience operating in a regional or multi-country context
  • Portuguese, Spanish and English fluency, given the Brazil & Colombia scope

title: Assistente de Logística Florestal Jr.
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4,6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano.

Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases de desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

  • Prestar suporte administrativo às rotinas da Logística Florestal, garantindo organização documental e cumprimento de prazos e processos internos;

title: Business Strategy Specialist
description:
About us

Keeta is a global technology company on a mission to help people eat better and live better. As part of one of the world's leading technology groups, we operate food delivery and marketplace platforms that connect millions of customers, merchants, and riders every day. We are building the future of food delivery — combining cutting-edge technology, operational excellence, and a deep commitment to customer experience.

The Role

The Strategy & Operations team is responsible for driving operational performance and strategic decision-making across Business, Consumer, and Delivery functions.

In this role, you will monitor business indicators, identify improvement opportunities, and translate data into actionable strategies that support sustainable growth. Working closely with Operations, Product, Marketing, and Commercial stakeholders, you will help shape the direction of key business initiatives and ensure alignment with company objectives.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor operational KPIs across business pillars, including merchant activation, customer retention, delivery SLAs, and cost efficiency, to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop dashboards, performance reports, and business analyses that provide leadership with clear visibility into operational health.
  • Analyze customer, merchant, rider, and operational data to identify performance gaps and recommend actions that improve efficiency and business results.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to implement strategic initiatives and track execution progress against business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Operations, Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams to drive continuous improvement and support business growth.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in Business Strategy, Performance Management, Business Intelligence, or Strategy Operations.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, dashboards, and data visualization tools.
  • Experience defining and monitoring operational KPIs and business performance metrics.
  • Ability to transform data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Data-driven professional with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Curious and proactive in identifying opportunities to improve business performance.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.
  • Strong communicator with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or related fields.
  • Availability to work on-site in São Paulo.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in technology, marketplaces, logistics, or food delivery companies.
  • Certifications in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, SQL, or Project Management.
  • Mandarin proficiency is a plus.

What We Offer

  • International and collaborative work environment.
  • High ownership and autonomy.
  • Opportunity to work on complex business challenges at scale.
  • Career growth in one of the world's leading technology companies.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Benefits

  • Meal and food allowance (Caju Card)
  • Transportation allowance
  • Health and dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Childcare assistance

How to Apply

If you're excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply through LinkedIn and submit your resume in English.

By applying, you acknowledge that your information will be processed securely and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates as part of the recruitment process.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter, Direct Placement
description:
About JetBridge AI

JetBridge has spent more than 12 years building software for companies ranging from a16z-backed startups to Fortune 500 enterprises like LabCorp and Pfizer. We serve clients in healthcare, biotech, manufacturing, retail, and logistics.

JetBridge AI is our platform for enterprise vibe coding. Customers build the first 80% of their apps and AI agents themselves, and our senior engineers harden the last 20% (integrations, security, compliance) so the work can safely go into production. Great engineers are at the center of everything we do, and we're hiring a Senior Technical Recruiter to find and place them.

The Role

This is a full-cycle, direct-placement recruiting role focused on software developers. You'll own every search from intake to signed offer, work directly with client hiring managers, move fast, and push for decisions. We're looking for someone hungry and accountable, who measures success in closed placements, not activity.

What You'll Do

  • Run full-cycle recruiting for software engineering roles: intake, sourcing, screening, submission, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and close
  • Partner with client technical hiring managers to understand each role, calibrate quickly, and get clear feedback on every candidate
  • Chase client responses so searches don't stall, and keep candidates engaged and informed
  • Source senior engineers through LinkedIn, GitHub, communities, referrals, and AI-powered sourcing tools
  • Run technical screens across modern stacks, including AI/ML, cloud, full-stack, and data engineering
  • Negotiate offers and manage closes through start date
  • Track pipeline metrics and improve time-to-submit, submit-to-interview ratio, and fill rate
  • Help bring AI tools and automation into our recruiting workflow

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of technical recruiting experience with a proven track record of direct-placement hires for software engineers
  • Full-cycle experience, agency-side, in-house, or both
  • Enough technical fluency to talk architectures, languages, and frameworks credibly with senior engineers
  • A closer's mentality. You follow up relentlessly and don't let deals go quiet
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your recruiting process
  • Business-fluent English (required). You'll negotiate directly with U.S. clients and senior candidates, in writing and on calls

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for healthcare, biotech, or enterprise clients
  • Bilingual English/Spanish or English/Portuguese

Compensation

  • Base salary: $3,000 USD/month
  • Commission: up to $1,500 USD/month, based on placements
  • Total monthly earning potential: $4,500 USD
  • Paid time off
  • Fully remote

How to Apply

Submit your resume along with a short video (2 to 3 minutes max) answering this question:

"What's your favorite new AI tool for recruiters, and how do you use it?"

Record your answer here:

Applications without a video will not be considered!

title: Gerente de Projetos - Transportes
description:
A Quadrante

Ao fazer parte do Grupo você terá a oportunidade de integrar um time jovem, dinâmico e ambicioso. Somos mais de 1100 profissionais empenhados no desenvolvimento das melhores soluções para o cliente e apostamos no crescimento profissional das nossas equipes, através da participação em projetos desafiantes

O espírito de colaboração está presente no nosso DNA, tanto através da partilha de conhecimentos no dia a dia, quanto através de iniciativas que reforçam a comunidade. Acreditamos no potencial de cada um e queremos ajudá-lo a desenvolver as suas capacidades.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o planejamento, execução, monitoramento e encerramento dos projetos de infraestrutura rodoferroviária sob sua responsabilidade, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da Quadrante e as expectativas do cliente.
  • Atuar como o principal ponto focal e representante da Quadrante perante o cliente em todas as fases do projeto, estabelecendo e mantendo um relacionamento de confiança e comunicação eficaz.
  • Gerenciar o escopo, cronograma, custo, qualidade, recursos e riscos dos projetos, aplicando as melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento e o progresso dos projetos, atuando na interface com os Líderes de Equipe e as equipes técnicas para assegurar o alinhamento e a comunicação com o cliente.
  • Atuar na interface com o cliente em todas as questões relativas à gestão de contratos, incluindo acompanhamento de termos, comunicação sobre aditivos e suporte na resolução de pleitos, em colaboração com as áreas jurídica, financeira e de operações.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com os Líderes de Equipe e as equipes multidisciplinares internas e externas, garantindo a integração das atividades, o fluxo de informações e o alinhamento com os objetivos do projeto.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento das normas técnicas, regulamentações ambientais, de segurança e de qualidade, interagindo com os Líderes de Equipe e as equipes responsáveis para assegurar que as diretrizes sejam aplicadas e reportar o status ao cliente e a diretoria.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e de progresso para a alta direção da Quadrante e para os clientes, apresentando status, desvios e planos de ação.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização e inovação nos processos e na execução dos projetos.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Civil, de Transportes, ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada (mínimo de 8 anos) na gestão de projetos de grande porte em infraestrutura, com foco em obras rodoferroviárias.
  • Experiência substancial e aprofundada com Obras de Arte Especiais (OAE), incluindo conhecimento em planejamento, acompanhamento e interface técnica.
  • Expertise comprovada em gestão de contratos complexos, com habilidade para atuar como ponto focal nas comunicações e discussões contratuais com o cliente.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das metodologias e melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMI, PMBOK,etc.).
  • Habilidade avançada no uso de softwares de gestão de projetos (MS Project, Primavera P6, ou similares).
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento interpessoal para atuar como principal ponto focal com clientes e stakeholders.
  • Liderança, proatividade, visão estratégica e habilidade para tomada de decisão em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, trabalhando em um modelo de gestão matricial.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens, conforme a necessidade dos projetos.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou equivalente.
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão de Projetos, Engenharia de Transportes, ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de modelagem (BIM/CAD).
  • Fluência em inglês e espanhol.
  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de engenharia.

title: Tech Lead - Data Architect
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Tech Lead / Arquiteto(a) de Dados altamente proativo(a), com forte experiência em Engenharia de Dados e domínio avançado do ecossistema Databricks, para liderar tecnicamente o desenho e a modernização de arquiteturas de dados em nuvem. Nesta função, você será responsável pela definição de padrões de modelagem de dados, governança e implementação de soluções analíticas avançadas no ecossistema Databricks, incluindo o uso de camadas semânticas e interfaces conversacionais baseadas em Databricks Genie.

  • Desenhar, evoluir e otimizar arquiteturas de Data Lake/Lakehouse garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e governança;
  • Definir e aplicar estratégias e metodologias de modelagem de dados (Star Schema, Data Vault, OBT, etc.) orientadas às necessidades de negócios;
  • Estruturar e implementar camadas semânticas no Databricks (incluindo Databricks Genie) para habilitar consultas em linguagem natural e self-service analytics;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de engenharia de dados e interlocutor junto aos stakeholders de negócio;

  • Sólida experiência prática atuando como Arquiteto(a) de Dados ou Tech Lead com forte background em Engenharia de Dados;
  • Domínio avançado do ecossistema Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, Genie);
  • Domínio de modelagem dimensional e relacional para cenários analíticos complexos;
  • Experiência com criação de camadas semânticas e habilitação de soluções analíticas/conversacionais via LLMs;
  • Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação fluida em ambiente corporativo);
  • Perfil proativo, com forte capacidade analítica e de liderança técnica.

title: Accounting Specialist
description:
Position Overview

The Accounting Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of the company's accounting records and reports.

The position acts as a technical reference within the Accounting function, supporting financial reporting, account analysis, consolidation, closing activities, internal controls, and continuous improvement of accounting processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting for the Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and Cash Flow Statement.
  • Prepare, analyze, and consolidate financial statements and accounting reports.
  • Perform account reconciliations and investigate variances and discrepancies.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting policies, internal controls, and applicable regulations.
  • Support internal and external audits.
  • Analyze accounting impacts of transactions, projects, and business initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, controls, and efficiency.
  • Provide accounting information, analysis, and recommendations to management.
  • Support budgeting and forecasting processes from an accounting perspective.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in Accounting or Controllership.
  • Experience with financial statements, reconciliations, closing processes, and consolidation.
  • Experience in energy or infrastructure companies is preferred.
  • Experience with ERP systems, preferably TOTVS.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, especially Excel.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.
  • Spanish is desirable.

Competencies

  • Strong technical accounting knowledge.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proactive, organized, and results-oriented.
  • Ability to work independently and act as a technical reference for the team.

Work Location & Availability

Location: Vila Olímpia, São Paulo – SP, Brazil

Travel: Availability to travel as required.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Compensation commensurate with experience.
  • Competitive benefits package.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.

description:
Descrição do Cargo: Operador / Gerente de Negócios de Crédito Automotivo- CORRESPONDENTE BANCÁRIO- C6 AUTO

Resumo da Posição Atuação no desenvolvimento da carteira de clientes e parceiros do segmento automotivo (concessionárias, multimarcas e revendas) com foco no financiamento de veículos. O profissional será responsável pelo ciclo completo das operações: da prospecção, atendimento e simulação de crédito à análise de métricas comerciais, gestão de performance da região e fortalecimento da marca local.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atendimento e Negociação: Prospecção e atendimento diário a clientes interessados em financiamento automotivo, com suporte consultivo para simulação de propostas, esclarecimento de taxas, prazos e apoio contratual.

  • Análise de Performance e Mercado: Acompanhamento de relatórios de vendas, conversão e produtividade, além do monitoramento de tendências do mercado automotivo e concorrência para subsidiar ações comerciais estratégicas.

Requisitos e Qualificações Exigidas

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Médio completo. Formação Superior (concluída ou em andamento) em Administração, Gestão Financeira, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas será considerada um diferencial.
  • Experiência: Vivência comprovada na área comercial do segmento automotivo, crédito bancário ou serviços financeiros, com histórico em gestão de carteira e relacionamento com lojas/concessionárias.

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro PL - Afirmativa PcD
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional com perfil analítico, visão crítica e orientação para dados, que tenha interesse em atuar de forma estratégica nas rotinas de planejamento e gestão financeira. Essa pessoa será responsável por apoiar o acompanhamento financeiro de uma área corporativa, participando da elaboração de orçamentos, projeções, cenários e análises de desempenho.

A posição terá forte interação com diferentes áreas do negócio e contribuirá para ampliar a visibilidade sobre resultados, despesas e tendências financeiras, gerando informações que apoiem a tomada de decisão.

Se você tem facilidade para interpretar números, identificar oportunidades a partir de dados e se comunicar com diferentes públicos, essa pode ser uma boa oportunidade para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar da elaboração do orçamento anual, realizando seu acompanhamento e as revisões necessárias ao longo do período.
  • Preparar projeções e forecasts financeiros, acompanhando mudanças de cenário e sinalizando possíveis riscos e oportunidades.

title: HR Specialist
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We've intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe HR is strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We're now looking for a tech-savvy, organized, and people-focused HR Specialist to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for an experienced HR professional who values autonomy, flexibility, and performance-based rewards. You'll work directly with clients, support their day-to-day people operations, and leverage technology to deliver efficient, practical, and high-quality HR support.

Please note: To be considered for this position, applicants must submit their resume in English. Applications with resumes submitted in other languages will not be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Provide day-to-day HR support for assigned clients, acting as an extension of their internal team and primary point of contact for HR-related matters.
  • Manage employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, employee changes, leave, offboarding, and maintaining accurate employee records.
  • Support clients with HR administration, policies, procedures, employee communications, and general HR questions.
  • Coordinate new hire onboarding, including HRIS setup, employment documentation, I-9 and W-4 processes, benefits enrollment, and onboarding materials.
  • Support recruiting activities, including job descriptions, candidate communications, interview coordination, offers, and pre-employment processes.
  • Assist managers and employees with employee relations matters, workplace concerns, performance issues, and policy questions.
  • Support and document employee relations matters and workplace investigations, escalating complex or sensitive issues when appropriate.
  • Assist with benefits administration, open enrollment, employee communications, and coordination with benefits providers and brokers.
  • Maintain and update employee handbooks, HR policies, forms, templates, and other HR documentation.
  • Research and support compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment requirements.
  • Coordinate with external payroll, benefits, accounting, legal, and other professional service providers as needed.
  • Manage and maintain HRIS systems and workflow platforms.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through various communication channels like Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, client requests, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve HR processes, automate administrative tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Develop clear employee-facing communications, manager resources, training materials, and HR guides.
  • Ensure HR work is accurate, timely, confidential, and aligned with Aerial Core's quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Strong knowledge of day-to-day HR processes and the employee lifecycle.
  • Experience supporting employee relations and handling confidential employee matters with discretion.
  • Strong understanding of HR administration, onboarding, benefits, compliance, and HR policies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple clients and priorities independently.
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time).
  • Comfortable working directly with clients and providing professional, practical HR guidance.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with US employment practices and HR compliance, including federal and state employment requirements.
  • Experience with common HRIS platforms like BambooHR and Workday.
  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools.
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we'll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You'll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.

The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

Ready to work differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a strategic, data-driven leader to drive performance, optimize commercial funnels, and scale our Inside Sales engine. In this role, you will bridge the gap between strategy and execution, connecting data analytics, lead management, and cross-functional alignment to accelerate merchant acquisition, activation, and growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Performance Management: Lead business planning for Inside Sales by translating high-level priorities into actionable targets, KPI frameworks, and strategic resource allocation.
  • Lead Engine & Funnel Optimization: Own the end-to-end merchant funnel. Define lead segmentation, scoring models, qualification criteria, and routing rules to maximize conversion rates and sales productivity.
  • Commercial Intelligence & Analytics: Conduct deep-dive analyses to uncover growth opportunities, diagnose performance bottlenecks, and deliver actionable insights directly to business leaders.
  • Dashboards & Governance: Build performance tracking dashboards and establish management routines (QBRs, weekly reviews) across acquisition, activation, retention, and merchant quality.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with CRM, Product, Marketing, Operations, and Analytics teams to enhance strategic capabilities across the entire merchant lifecycle.
  • Strategic Initiatives: Scope and execute high-impact projects designed to scale the efficiency, tooling, and infrastructure of the Inside Sales organization.

Job Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in Sales Operations, Strategy & Operations, Commercial Strategy, Business Analytics, or Management Consulting.
  • Analytical Mastery: Proven ability to work with complex datasets, build clear dashboards, and translate raw data into executive-ready insights.
  • Funnel Expertise: Deep understanding of commercial funnels, sales productivity metrics, and lead management systems.
  • Leadership & Execution: Structured problem-solving skills, strong business judgment, and the ability to drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Adaptability: Track record of operating independently and navigating ambiguity in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  • Languages: Fluent/Business English (written and spoken).

title: Eletromecânico de Manutenção
description:
ELETROMECÂNICO DE MANUTENÇÃO

Conheça um pouco sobre a Alliance One

A Alliance One é uma das maiores empresas do mundo em negócios com tabaco, sinônimo de geração de renda e empregos, tendo mais de 95% de sua produção exportada para os cinco continentes. A empresa conta com operações de produção de tabaco e de outras commodities em 14 países distribuídos nos 5 continentes, envolvendo cerca de 80 mil produtores contratados. Desde sua criação, vem se tornando referência em inovação, competitividade, vanguarda tecnológica e responsabilidade social, sempre com foco no desenvolvimento sustentável.

No Brasil conta, anualmente, com cerca de 3 mil empregados diretos, em todas as suas instalações. A capacidade instalada de processamento de tabaco nas unidades fabris da companhia é de 220 mil toneladas/ano.

Com atuação em cerca de 350 municípios, através de suas equipes de campo, a empresa investe forte na relação com seus 16 mil produtores integrados, sempre focada nos princípios e práticas de sustentabilidade.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em atividades de manutenção corretiva e preventiva de sistemas elétricos e mecânicos de máquinas e equipamentos;
  • Realizar manutenção e instalações elétricas prediais e industriais;
  • Interpretar desenhos, croquis e outros dados técnicos necessários a modificação e fabricação peças;
  • Atender os objetivos internos e metas de sustentabilidade da Companhia, colaborando com a redução no consumo de energias.

Requisitos

  • Modo de trabalho: Presencial;
  • Localização: Rio Azul – PR;
  • Formação em Técnico em Eletromecânica ou Técnico Eletrotécnico;
  • Certificação NR10 - 40 horas;
  • Conhecimento em montagens elétricas industriais, painéis elétricos e infraestrutura elétrica predial;
  • Conhecimento em solda elétrica, oxiacetileno e corte a plasma;
  • Conhecimento em pneumática e hidráulica básica;
  • Desejável conhecimento em usinagem e lubrificação industrial;
  • Desejável conhecimento em informática (Word, Excel, Power Point...);
  • Proatividade, organização e foco em resultado;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;

title: Especialista de Planejamento Estratégico e Incorporação
description:

title: Assistente jurídico B2B com 2 anos de experiência em grandes escritórios
description:
About us

Jumpstart Immigration provides a safer, more reliable path for global founders and skilled professionals seeking U.S. residency or work visas. We simplify complex immigration processes by combining high-level legal expertise with statistical models and artificial intelligence.

Through our exclusive Founders Package, we support a holistic transition to the U.S., encompassing immigration strategy, company formation partnerships, tax planning, and relocation services. We are a strategic partner for high-talent visa and Green Card categories, including O-1, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, E-2, L-1, and H-1B.

Website:

Role description

We are looking for an Immigration Paralegal to help turn our clients' professional achievements into well-documented, compelling immigration petitions.

Working closely with our attorneys and operations team, you will support case preparation from document review through final petition assembly, ensuring each case is accurate, consistent, and ready for attorney review on schedule.

This role requires excellent English writing skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple cases in a fast-paced environment. All substantive legal work will be performed under attorney supervision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evidence Review and Organization: Review client documents, identify missing information or inconsistencies, and organize supporting evidence according to the attorney-defined case strategy.
  • Drafting: Prepare drafts of petition support letters, recommendation letters, professional background summaries, and other supporting materials for attorney review.
  • Research: Conduct factual and legal research under attorney direction to support case development and document clients' achievements.
  • Petition Assembly and Quality Control: Compile exhibits, prepare indexes, and cross-check names, dates, citations, translations, and supporting documents before final attorney review.
  • Deadline Management: Track drafting milestones, filing deadlines, and attorney review cycles across multiple active cases.
  • Post-Filing Support: Assist attorneys with responses to Requests for Evidence (RFEs) and other case-related requests.
  • Process Improvement: Help improve templates, checklists, and workflows, using technology and AI tools responsibly while protecting confidential information and verifying outputs.

Qualifications

  • Relevant Experience: Previous experience as a paralegal or legal assistant.
  • Advanced/Fluent English: Excellent written English and the ability to communicate clearly with international clients and team members are essential.
  • Writing and Research Skills: Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, accurate, and well-supported drafts.
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to identify inconsistencies across forms, supporting documents, and written narratives.
  • Case Management: Experience handling multiple matters, maintaining organized records, and meeting deadlines.
  • Technology Proficiency: Comfortable working with document management systems, collaborative tools, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Education: A degree in Law, paralegal training, or a related field is a plus.

The Ideal Profile

  • Organized and Accountable: You take ownership of deliverables, keep case files structured, and flag risks before they affect deadlines.
  • Analytical: You connect evidence to the case strategy and recognize when additional documentation or attorney guidance is needed.
  • A Strong Writer: You produce clear, precise drafts grounded in the client's records.
  • Collaborative: You work effectively with attorneys and operations colleagues and incorporate feedback quickly.
  • Proactive: You anticipate next steps and move cases forward with appropriate supervision.
  • Discreet and Professional: You handle sensitive personal and business information with care.

Location & Compensation

This is a fully remote position, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere. The role involves occasional in-person meetups for strategic planning and team building.

  • Compensation: R$ 8.000,00 per month (PJ)
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Start date: Immediately

description:

A Unick360 é uma agência de comunicação e publicidade que atua no desenvolvimento de estratégias, campanhas, conteúdos e soluções criativas para marcas de diferentes segmentos.

Procuramos um(a) profissional que pense como redator(a) publicitário(a) e não apenas como produtor(a) de conteúdo.

É importante ter capacidade de transitar entre diferentes formatos: de uma headline de campanha a um roteiro de vídeo; de uma legenda de Instagram a um texto de embalagem; de um anúncio digital a uma peça impressa.

Também buscamos alguém que tenha um olhar cuidadoso para a revisão e consiga identificar não apenas erros gramaticais, mas também problemas de clareza, coerência, linguagem e adequação da comunicação.

Localização e formato de prestação de serviços

Belo Horizonte/MG

Preferência por profissionais de Belo Horizonte e região, com possibilidade de prestação de serviços em formato híbrido, conforme alinhamento entre as partes e necessidades dos projetos.

Outras localidades do Brasil

A oportunidade também está aberta para profissionais de todo o Brasil, com atuação em formato remoto.

Processo seletivo

1. Análise de currículo e portfólio

Avaliação inicial do currículo e do portfólio profissional.

2. Formulário de candidatura

Os profissionais selecionados na primeira etapa receberão um formulário para preenchimento com informações complementares sobre experiência, conhecimentos e atuação profissional.

3. Entrevista com RH

Conversa inicial para conhecer melhor o profissional, sua experiência, perfil e alinhamento com a oportunidade.

4. Entrevista com o gestor

Os profissionais que avançarem participarão de uma conversa com o gestor responsável pela área, com aprofundamento sobre experiência, conhecimentos técnicos, repertório e forma de atuação.

5. Proposta de prestação de serviços

Após a conclusão das etapas, o profissional selecionado receberá uma proposta comercial para prestação de serviços PJ, contendo as condições, escopo e demais informações referentes à contratação.

Importante sobre a oportunidade

Esta é uma oportunidade de prestação de serviços como pessoa jurídica (PJ), formalizada por meio de contrato de prestação de serviços entre as partes.

A atuação será realizada de acordo com o escopo, entregas, condições comerciais e demais termos estabelecidos na proposta e no contrato, não se tratando de contratação pelo regime CLT.

Belo Horizonte/MG: possibilidade de prestação de serviços em formato híbrido.

Demais localidades do Brasil: prestação de serviços em formato remoto.

title: Analista de Capacitação Comercial Júnior
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e o Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados mundiais nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com uma das maiores carteiras de seguros do mercado, temos sede na Espanha e comercializamos nossos produtos por meio do canal de vendas do Banco Santander no Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.

Na Zurich Santander, trabalhamos todos os dias para que você seja o protagonista de nossa história e tenha o espaço que merece dentro da nossa empresa. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, este é o seu lugar!

Nosso objetivo é oferecer a você as melhores experiências, queremos que se junte a nós para que juntos possamos construir o futuro da Zurich Santander!

Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades?

  • Dar suporte administrativo à área,
  • Fazer gestão de fornecedores e processos de compras, realizar curadoria e gestão de conteúdos educacionais, como organização, catalogação, atualização e disponibilização de materiais de treinamento, assegurando a qualidade e aderência dos conteúdos às necessidades do negócio,
  • Acompanhamento de projetos de capacitação, suporte operacional às ações de treinamento e integração com a área comercial.

Quais são os requisitos que procuramos?

  • Formação superior completa ou em fase final de conclusão em:

Administração de Empresas; Engenharia; Economia; Estatística; Ciências Atuariais; Gestão de Negócios; Ou áreas correlatas.

  • Desejável experiência prévia (estágio, programa de trainee ou posição inicial) em:

Instituições financeiras; Bancos; Seguradoras; Consultorias; Empresas de serviços financeiros.

  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado do Pacote Office, com destaque para:

Excel; PowerPoint; Outlook.

  • Desejável conhecimento em: Ferramentas de gestão de projetos; Sistemas corporativos de compras e fornecedores; Plataformas de treinamento (LMS).
  • Espanhol intermediário ou avançado (desejável).
  • Inglês será considerado diferencial.

Para que possa fazer a diferença, é ideal que você tenha as seguintes softskills para esta função:

  • O candidato deverá apresentar perfil analítico, organizado e proativo, capaz de atuar como suporte estratégico e operacional da área de Capacitação Comercial, garantindo eficiência nos processos administrativos, acompanhamento de projetos e organização das iniciativas de desenvolvimento dos profissionais de vendas.

Qual é a nossa Proposta de Valor?

Consultant — 1 to 3 years of experience, ideally started at a top-tier strategy consulting firm. You'll bring creative input to projects, independently structure and synthesize analysis, support client presentations, and grow with mentorship from consulting leaders.

Associate Managing Consultant — 3 to 5 years of experience. You'll manage deliverables and workstreams, create impactful storylines, own client relationships at manager level, and coach junior consultants.

  • Build trusted working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders (Product, Business Development)
  • Prepare and deliver effective, business-focused client presentations with impactful storylines

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Undergraduate degree + 1 to 2+ years of experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm (e.g., insert target firms). Candidates who have since moved to boutique consultancies or to industry roles are welcome, as long as they bring that strategy consulting foundation
  • Hands-on experience in corporate strategy, business transformation, or growth strategy projects

  • Experience managing clients, internal stakeholders, and/or teams (scope grows with level)
  • Advanced Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

PLEASE NOTE

This role is not a fit for profiles whose experience is focused on Supply Chain PMO or Finance Strategy (FP&A, M&A, Portfolio Management).

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing workstreams in collaborative environments with third parties
  • Track record generating new knowledge or innovative solutions for a firm

  • MBA or master's degree with relevant specialization (not required)

Nascemos no interior de Goiás e, de pouquinho em pouquinho, ganhamos espaço na vida das famílias brasileiras.

Desde 1955, conquistamos o respeito de todos fazendo sempre o melhor para as pessoas, parceiros e planeta!

Cada dia na Americanas é uma oportunidade de transformar desafios em soluções; ideias em realizações. Estamos comprometidos em fazer a diferença, cuidando das nossas pessoas e contribuindo para um impacto positivo não só para os nossos stakeholders, mas para toda a sociedade.

Se você quer fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza a autenticidade, a inovação e o trabalho coletivo, venha fazer parte da Americanas S.A. Aqui, crescemos juntos, resolvemos a vida de milhões e criamos histórias que inspiram.

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 96 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.400 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é amar resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Acquisition Onboarding Manager
description:
ISP Acquisition Onboarding Manager (OBM)

Reporting to: Senior Acquisition Onboarding Manager

Location: Remote, Brazil with travel to acquired schools within LATAM region as required

Purpose of the role

As an Acquisition Onboarding Manager (OBM) at ISP, you play a pivotal role in the successful integration of newly acquired schools into the ISP group, from completion through to a fully onboarded, compliant and operationally ready.

This is a dynamic and hands-on role that combines PMO discipline with hands-on delivery execution. You will not only oversee the integration plan but also actively contribute to the completion of critical tasks, particularly in time-sensitive areas such as Finance. You'll be the central point of accountability for the onboarding timeline, progress tracking, risk mitigation, and issue resolution.

The OBM does not sit behind a dashboard reporting on other people's progress; the OBM makes things happen.

Stepping in is a judgement call, not a default. You step in to unblock delivery, protect a milestone, or build capability in a school that does not yet have it – not to permanently absorb work that belongs to a function or a region, as it covers every function involved in bringing a school into ISP.

You proactively business partner with the School Leadership team on one side, and the Regional, Divisional and Group functions on the other, facilitating both sides to work as one. You translate the group onboarding plan into something a school can deliver, and you translate the school's reality back into decisions, escalations and support from the region and Group.

You will be structured, credible with senior level stakeholders, comfortable challenging functions and regions, and capable of holding a complex plan together across multiple countries, languages and time zones – while remaining close enough to the detail to deliver it yourself when that is what the school needs.

Key Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management:

  • Act as the primary link between Group Business Development, regional leadership, and school teams, ensuring sharing of key information and objectives post-acquisition.
  • Work with Group Heads of Function to ensure onboarding task lists are actionable, prioritised, and well understood by operational teams.
  • Facilitate interdepartmental collaboration to align on key tasks, timelines, and deliverables, encouraging open communication and timely issue resolution.
  • Support a culture of continual learning and sharing by facilitating knowledge transfer sessions and contributing to onboarding process refinement.

Regional Management & Regional Support:

  • Lead the development of customised onboarding project plans in monday.com for each school, ensuring alignment with ISP's integration framework and timelines.
  • Guide regional and school teams in understanding their onboarding responsibilities and deliverables.
  • Monitor progress across all functional areas, identifying delays early, assessing risks and impacts and coordinating with stakeholders to implement corrective measures.
  • Provide practical assistance and support in completing assigned, time-critical tasks where there are capacity or capability challenges.
  • Work closely with the Regional Managing Director & Senior Onboarding Manager to prioritise resource allocation and manage project load to ensure timely delivery of all onboarding milestones.

Integration Planning & Execution:

  • Review Financial Investment Papers (FIPs), Sale & Purchase Agreements (SPAs), core M&A Due Diligences (DD's) and other acquisition documentation to ensure critical obligations and timelines are captured in the onboarding plan.
  • Tailor integration task lists across departments including HR, Finance, Learning, Marketing, Technology, Legal, and Operations to reflect each school's structure, priorities and dependencies.
  • Collaborate with other Onboarding Managers and Group Heads of Function to regularly review and improve the integration task library, embedding best practices and feedback from prior projects. International Schools Partnership - General Document
  • Conduct regular status meetings to track progress, manage interdependencies, and ensure that regional and school teams are supported throughout the onboarding lifecycle.
  • Proactively escalate material risks and propose mitigation actions to ensure minimal disruption to school operations and the project timeline.

PMO tool (Monday.com) Administration & Reporting:

  • Maintain and update our project management tool, currently monday.com, on boards for all active projects, ensuring they reflect real-time status, deadlines, and dependencies.
  • Provide guidance and training to regional and school staff on monday.com to support adoption and effective use, as well as project inclusion for all key stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain real-time dashboards and produce regular status reports and updates for regional leadership and ISP Group executives.
  • Ensure consistency and transparency in reporting to support strategic decision-making and highlight areas needing additional support.

Essential skills

  • Cross-functional leadership. Ability to coordinate 15+ functional teams, across multiple schools teams each with its own timelines, dependencies and regulatory requirements.
  • Structured planning and dependency management. Builds and maintains the master onboarding plan, sequencing complex interdependent tasks
  • Risk identification and mitigation. Proactively surfaces risks across all workstreams (regulatory filings, safer recruitment, tax liabilities, property compliance) and drives mitigation actions.
  • Stakeholder communication and governance. Ensures clear, consistent communication between Group, Regional and School stakeholders; facilitates governance meetings and decision-making.
  • Change management. Supports the school through transitions to new systems, policies, reporting structures and compliance expectations.
  • Documentation and reporting. Maintains accurate records, meeting minutes, onboarding reports and audit ready documentation.
  • Hands-on delivery. Comfortable working in the detail and completing tasks personally when a school or function is blocked, rather than only tracking and escalating.

Success measures / KPIs Including, but not limited to:

  • Time to integrate (number of days from completion to final stage gate)
  • Milestone adherence (%)
  • Service standard adherence (% of SLA commitments met per acquisition)
  • Quality of execution (number of reported issues / escalations)
  • Reporting accuracy and timeliness (%)
  • Stakeholder satisfaction, including Head of School and RMD feedback (NPS or score)
  • Lessons learned / process improvement implementation rate (%)

Experience, qualifications and skills

  • Education and experience. +3 Years Experience in project management, mergers & acquisitions and/or post merger integration, preferably within a multi-regional or international organization. A professional qualification and/or master's degree in business administration, project management or a related field is highly desirable.
  • Technical skills. Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools, especially monday.com, allied to confident, practical use of AI and large language models to accelerate document and due diligence review, drafting, analysis and reporting – applied with sound judgement on data confidentiality and verification of outputs. Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel for analysis and tracking and PowerPoint for executive reporting.
  • Technology and data. Working familiarity with the ISP system landscape (Workday, NetSuite, iSAMS, ClassLink, HubSpot) is an advantage. Comfortable working with data across systems: structuring and reconciling data sets, understanding how school data flows into group reporting, and building and maintaining dashboards from a single source of truth. Exposure to data warehouse or data lake environments, Power BI (DAX Language), and any scripting or workflow automation experience (SQL, Python, Power Automate) is desirable rather than essential. International Schools Partnership - General Document
  • Commercial, legal and financial literacy. Sufficient financial literacy to run the finance workstream credibly with an RFD and a School Business Manager, understand Due Diligence technical reports and legal deal terms.
  • Communication skills. Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to influence, present to senior audiences and build collaborative relationships at all levels.
  • Change management. Demonstrated experience guiding teams through cultural and operational change in a fast-paced, acquisitive environment.
  • Languages. Fluent English is essential. Additional languages are highly desirable depending on the region.
  • Teamwork and independence. Able to work independently while operating effectively in cross-functional, multicultural and multi-time-zone teams.
  • Adaptability. Flexibility to adapt to different working styles, organizational structures and changing project demands.

ISP commitment to safeguarding principles

ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years' employment history.

ISP commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging

ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Revenue Accountant
description:
US Accounting Ownership. Long-Term Global Partnerships.

MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly into their finance operations. This is not a back-office accounting role — you will be embedded directly within US finance teams, operating as a trusted partner to US leadership.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Revenue Accountant to own the revenue cycle end to end for US-based clients — from contract to recognised revenue to cash.

You will work in lean, high-trust environments where revenue is the number everyone watches. You will own how it is recognised, why it moved, and whether it will survive an audit. Your accuracy and process ownership directly support business growth.

What You Will Own

  • Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the five-step assessment, performance obligations, allocation, and timing
  • Review customer contracts, order forms, and amendments for revenue impact, and flag terms that do not fit the established treatment
  • Own the deferred revenue roll-forward, contract asset and liability schedules, and unbilled receivables
  • Own the revenue close — journal entries, accruals, cut-off, and revenue reconciliations — within the monthly close calendar
  • Reconcile revenue and deferred revenue between the billing system, the CRM, and the general ledger, and resolve differences to root cause
  • Oversee subscription billing, invoicing accuracy, and the AR sub-ledger, and support collections with accurate customer balances
  • Prepare ARR, NRR, churn, and revenue reporting for US stakeholders, and tie it back to the audited revenue number
  • Perform revenue variance analysis and explain the movements — price, volume, mix, timing — in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Maintain audit-ready revenue documentation, including the memoranda supporting significant judgements
  • Prepare revenue PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries on revenue through to resolution
  • Support the broader month-end close, general ledger integrity, and supporting schedules alongside your revenue areas
  • Collaborate directly with US Controllers, CFOs, and finance leadership, and partner with Sales and RevOps on deal structuring and billing questions
  • Drive process improvements and automation across the contract-to-cash cycle

What We're Looking For

  • 4–6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure, including hands-on revenue accounting
  • Practical depth in ASC 606 — not familiarity, but having applied it to real contracts and defended the conclusion
  • Experience with deferred revenue, subscription or recurring-revenue models, and multi-element arrangements
  • Experience reconciling revenue between a billing system and the general ledger
  • Strong reconciliation discipline and the ability to investigate a variance through to root cause
  • Experience supporting an audit, including revenue PBC preparation and direct auditor contact
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, or equivalent)
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to explain a revenue position to a non-accountant
  • Availability for US time zone overlap

Preferred

  • SaaS, marketplace, or usage-based revenue experience, including ARR and NRR mechanics
  • Experience with billing and revenue platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora, Maxio, Recurly, or NetSuite ARM
  • CPA, CA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or active progress toward one
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company
  • Experience through an ASC 606 adoption, a revenue system implementation, or a first audit

Why Join MAVI?

  • Own the revenue number for high-growth US companies — the line every investor and board looks at first
  • Build ASC 606 and recurring-revenue depth that travels with your career rather than with one employer
  • Long-term partnerships with high-growth US companies
  • Direct exposure to US finance and technology leaders
  • Broader ownership vs. traditional accounting roles
  • Flexible remote-first work culture
  • Opportunity to grow within a global finance network

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

  • Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
  • Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.
  • Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.
  • Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.
  • Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.
  • Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.
  • Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.
  • Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem.
  • Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here.
  • Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side.
  • Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong.
  • Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits.
  • Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit.
  • Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did.
  • Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support.
  • Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

  • Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar.
  • Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange.
  • Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

  • Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year
  • Paid vacation
  • Full medical insurance
  • Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered
  • Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company
  • Budget for professional courses and certifications
  • Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

Buscamos um profissional com perfil analítico, capacidade de observação clínica e raciocínio diagnóstico, que atue de forma colaborativa em equipe multiprofissional. É fundamental possuir comunicação clara e acolhedora, organização para elaboração de documentos técnicos e comprometimento com a qualidade assistencial. Valorizamos profissionais que demonstrem interesse por desenvolvimento contínuo, prática baseada em evidências e cuidado centrado na pessoa e sua família.

  • Realizar avaliações fonoaudiológicas voltadas ao desenvolvimento da comunicação, linguagem, fala, pragmática e funções orais.
  • Participar do processo de investigação diagnóstica de condições do neurodesenvolvimento, atuando de forma integrada à equipe multiprofissional.
  • Elaborar pareceres, relatórios e devolutivas técnicas para famílias, profissionais assistentes e auditorias, quando necessário.
  • Aplicar e interpretar protocolos e instrumentos de avaliação padronizados conforme as diretrizes institucionais.
  • Participar de reuniões clínicas e discussões de caso com a equipe interdisciplinar.
  • Contribuir para a construção de planos terapêuticos e recomendações assistenciais.
  • Orientar familiares e cuidadores sobre estratégias de estimulação e manejo da comunicação.
  • Registrar informações em prontuário eletrônico de forma ética, completa e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Participar de capacitações, treinamentos e iniciativas de melhoria contínua dos processos assistenciais.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação necessária para a Posição:

  • Graduação em Fonoaudiologia.
  • Registro ativo e regular no Conselho Regional de Fonoaudiologia (CREFONO).

Qualificações Desejáveis/Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento infantil e transtornos do neurodesenvolvimento.
  • Experiência em avaliação fonoaudiológica.
  • Complementam perfil formações especializadas na área do desenvolvimento/TEA.
  • Experiência com Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA).
  • Vivência em equipes multiprofissionais de saúde.
  • Conhecimento e experiência na aplicação de protocolos padronizados de avaliação.
  • Formação complementar em linguagem, comunicação alternativa, desenvolvimento infantil ou áreas correlatas.

title: Director of Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
description:

  • Define, implement, and lead the corporate GRC strategy, aligned with the organization's strategic planning.
  • Ensure regulatory, legal and contractual compliance of operations, with a focus on tax and accounting areas.
  • Map, assess and mitigate operational, regulatory and tax risks, ensuring the integrity of critical processes.
  • Ensure the independence and autonomy of the governance, risk, and compliance functions, with direct access to senior management and governance bodies.

  • Solid experience in leadership positions within Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC).
  • Experience in implementing or evolving compliance programs, internal controls and risk management.
  • Experience liaising with internal and external auditors as well as regulatory bodies.
  • In-depth knowledge of global market methodologies, such as COSO (Enterprise Risk Management) and ISO 31000 and ISO 37301 standards.
  • Experience with corporate risk management and internal controls.
  • Solid understanding of labor, tax and antitrust legislation, as well as data protection laws (such as LGPD and GDPR) and anti-corruption laws.
  • Familiarity with technology frameworks (COBIT and ITIL) and security standards (ISO 27001).
  • Ability to use BI (Business Intelligence) tools and GRC platforms to monitor risk indicators in real-time.

  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in areas such as Compliance, Corporate Governance, Auditing or Risk Management.
  • Proficiency in English. Ability to engage and persuade various executive boards to voluntarily adopt ethical and secure practices.
  • Emotional stability to lead sensitive internal investigations, handle regulatory inspections and respond to serious incidents if necessary.

description:
#NossoJeitoDeSer

Aqui no Grupo Carrefour Brasil vivemos o #NossoJeitoDeSer todos os dias. O Cliente está no centro da Excelência em tudo o que fazemos, e é ele quem guia nossas decisões e inspira nossas entregas.
