title: Queue Lead
description:
Start date: TBC

End Date: TBC

Location: Remote

Type of contract: Freelance

Languages required: English

Hourly Rate: Include the rate you are comfortable with on your CV.

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Role

We are seeking a Queue Lead to join a high-priority initiative in partnership with a leading AI company. This is an operational, hands-on role, you will own day-to-day execution for one or more annotation queues on a live AI training/eval program: managing throughput, running quality calibrations, tracking contributor performance, and building out reporting systems that keep stakeholders informed in real time.

You will have experience running queues and quality on AI data programs. The selected candidate will be able to speak to specific projects, calibration processes they've built, and contributor performance systems they've run.

What you'll be doing

Queue Operations & Task Management

  • Own work queues: intake, triage, prioritization, task assignment, and SLA delivery
  • Monitor task queue and backlog control
  • Identify and troubleshoot bottlenecks (unclear policy, tooling issues, supply gaps)

Quality Assurance & Performance Management

  • Monitor quality at project and individual annotator or contributor level.
  • Perform QA tasks such as making corrections, providing annotator feedback, flagging systematic confusion and suggestions to team lead.
  • Manage annotator or contributor performance by performing tasks like unassigning underperformers, identifying and retaining high-performers.

Reporting & Dashboards

  • Build and maintain dashboards to track throughput, disagreement rates, defect or rework rates, and contributor performance.
  • Turn raw queue data into clear, actionable reporting for stakeholders.
  • Provide feedback for process improvements based on data trends.

Training & Support

  • Oversee dedicated Slack channels by answering participant questions, providing support, and escalating complex issues to the Client Delivery Lead.
  • Train new annotators or contributors on project guidelines.
  • Conduct live or recorded webinars as new participants join projects.
  • Host "office hours" for participants.
  • Oversee dedicated Slack channels by answering questions, providing support, escalating complex issues to Client Delivery Lead.

What you'll bring

  • Proven, direct experience running queues and quality on AI data programs, ideally at a competitor.
  • 3+ years in high-throughput ops (data labeling, trust & safety, BPO, content ops, CX ops), with recent, specific AI data ops experience
  • Able to identify shallow, low-effort, AI-generated, or phoned-in responses.
  • Proven ability to design and run calibration processes from scratch.
  • Ability to track record by building or maintaining dashboards or reporting systems (spreadsheets is required, SQL/BI/Looker/Tableau a strong plus)
  • Experience managing contributor performance at scale including making retention or removal decisions.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities on live programs.

What "good" looks like for us:

  • Scale up to running a full AI end-to-end data program, owning pipeline, throughput, calibration, and contributor performance at program level.
  • Operates as an AI training consultant, you are comfortable advising on processes and methodology.

Bonus

  • Experience with ML data or LLM eval workflows (ranking, rubric-based judging, gold sets, calibration)
  • Distributed team coordination across time zones; vendor or contract workforce experience
  • Consulting-style experience of advising clients on AI training methodology.

Success looks like

Predictable SLA delivery, a stable backlog, improving quality and reducing rework, and proactive dashboards reporting that give stakeholders real-time visibility.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Brazil User Research Consultant - Beauty & Imaging (3-Month Contract)
description:
Remote | Project-based | September–November 2026

Why We Need You:

Meitu is the team behind BeautyPlus, AirBrush, and MagicPic, and we're digging into how beauty and imaging professionals in Brazil think about aesthetics, makeup, and visual expression. This project is all about talking to retouchers, photographers, makeup artists, and medical aesthetics practitioners to understand what actually resonates in the Brazilian market. We need someone based in Brazil who can help us listen, translate, and make sense of what users really mean.

What You'll Do:

  • Support 15+ user interviews with participants mostly in Brazil and a few in the US; provide Portuguese-English translation and, once trained, run interviews independently at times that work for Brazilian users.
  • Help the team understand the local context behind what people say, including cultural cues, implied meaning, and the way Brazilian users naturally talk about beauty and imagery.
  • Write a clear summary after each interview and help with participant scheduling or follow-ups when needed.
  • Review Brazilian Portuguese questionnaire copy to make sure it sounds natural, flag anything confusing or unnatural, and do a basic readability pass on any English versions.
  • Gather and organize desk research on Brazilian beauty and imagery culture from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp, and Kwai, then turn observations into clear local insights.

Who You Are:

  • You're currently living, studying, or working in Brazil and you get how Brazilian users create, talk, and express themselves online.
  • You're fluent in Portuguese with a strong feel for natural Brazilian Portuguese wording, and you can communicate with the project team in English or Chinese.
  • You're familiar with the social platforms Brazilian users actually use: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, WhatsApp, and Kwai.
  • You're interested in or already close to medical aesthetics, makeup, photography, or another visual field.
  • You can organize research notes, summarize findings, and pull out patterns without losing local nuance.
  • You can maintain relatively stable availability from September to November while the project is running.

Even Better If You:

· You're bilingual in Portuguese and Chinese.

title: Fiat Operations Specialist
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world's leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Mission

As a Fiat Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for driving the integration of local payment methods that allow users to deposit and withdraw BRL. You will collaborate closely with product, compliance, and tech teams to improve the fiat on&off-ramp experience for users. A key aspect of this role is working with the product team to identify opportunities to build the smooth user experience, ensuring that payment flows are intuitive, seamless, and aligned with customer and regulatory needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage BRL on/off-ramp channels end-to-end, ensuring availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for brazilian banks and payment vendors, payment service providers (PSPs), card processors, and other fiat partners, managing relationships, negotiations, and day-to-day communication to ensure reliable and efficient payment channels.
  • Lead and coordinate technical integrations with local banks and payment gateways, working alongside engineering and product teams to ensure seamless implementation and ongoing maintenance of payment infrastructure;
  • Ensure seamless user access to fiat products, minimizing friction in deposits and withdrawals.
  • Monitor and manage the end-to-end operational process for fiat on&off-ramps, ensuring smooth transactions and rapid issue resolution for users.
  • Identify emerging trends in user preferences, and regulatory changes in Brazil to adapt our platform accordingly.
  • Work closely with Customer Support to resolve user issues related to deposits, withdrawals, and transaction status, including handling workflows and tickets raised by the CS team that are related to fiat operations.
  • Maintain strong relationships with banking partners, payment service providers (PSPs), card processors, and other fiat partners.
  • Ensure liquidity and operational stability of BRL fiat flows and payment channels.
  • Use data and metrics to optimize payment integrations, minimize friction for users, and enhance the overall user experience;
  • Work closely with the product team to improve the overall user experience of fiat on&off-ramp processes. Provide insights and feedback based on user behavior, transaction data, and customer feedback to inform product enhancements that improve payment flow, reduce friction, and increase user satisfaction.
  • Support fiat on/off-ramp operations for additional currencies (e.g., ARS and others), as applicable.
  • Monitor daily fiat operations, ensuring accurate processing, timely settlements, and proper reconciliation between internal systems and external partners.
  • Coordinate card and payment infrastructure partners for Brazilian users, ensuring smooth operation of payment flows, supporting issue resolution and complaints handling, and actively participating in the design and improvement of these processes.
  • Maintain and improve operational controls (limits, reconciliation routines, cut-off times, monitoring alerts).
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve operational incidents, ensuring proper escalation and root cause analysis.
  • Keep SOPs, runbooks, and operational documentation up to date and aligned with actual processes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams to improve fiat infrastructure and processes.
  • Act as a key advocate for the user experience, ensuring that payment-related touchpoints are designed to be intuitive, frictionless, and aligned with user needs and expectations.

Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in payment operations, banking, fintech in Brazil.
  • Payments&Banking Background: Demonstrated experience in the payments or banking industry, with a strong understanding of the brazilian financial ecosystem, local payment rails, and banking operations;
  • Technical Integration Experience: Hands-on experience coordinating technical integrations with banks, payment providers; ability to bridge communication between technical and business teams.
  • Regulatory Awareness: Familiarity with brazilian financial regulations, anti-money laundering practices, KYCcompliance, and payment industry standards.
  • Project Management: Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Problem Solving: Analytical thinker with a proactive approach to identifying issues and implementing effective solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and liaise with internal and external stakeholders including banks and vendors.
  • Languages: Fluency in both English and Portuguese is required (written and verbal). Additional languages are a plus.

Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Accounting is a U.S.-based financial services firm with a team of 250+ professionals across the United States, Argentina, Chile, Brazil, Ecuador, Peru, Mexico, and the Philippines. We help small and mid-size businesses build strong financial foundations — and we are growing.

We are looking for an experienced Accounting Manager to join our team and take full ownership of client accounting outcomes within our proven TGG Way methodology.

Responsibilities

Weekly Operations

  • Review customer invoicing and manage the AR cycle.
  • Review vendor bills, approve AP, and submit payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform P&L scrubs and review cash flow forecasts.
  • Resolve collections issues and escalate exceptions.
  • Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller.

Monthly Close & Reporting

  • Lead the month-end close: complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook.
  • Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook and reconcile supporting schedules.
  • Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff Accountant.
  • Review financial statements, supporting schedules, and financial packages prepared by the Staff Accountant.
  • Understand the purpose of existing KPIs, roll them forward monthly, and confirm accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes.
  • Maintain process and procedural documentation, and provide technical feedback to Staff Accountants to strengthen their accounting skills.

Quarterly & Annual Compliance

  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Review the chart of accounts and recommend corrections.
  • Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency.

New Client Implementation

  • Audit the new client's existing processes and procedural documentation.
  • Recommend and document updated SOPs for Controller sign-off.
  • Build core financial templates and initial reports: Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package.
  • Train and delegate ongoing operational tasks to Staff Accountants.

This Role Is for You If

  • You have experience managing or supervising a team.
  • You have demonstrated experience working with or within U.S.-based companies or clients, and exposure to U.S. GAAP.
  • You have 4+ years of accounting experience, and you take your work seriously.
  • You thrive in a structured, high-accountability remote environment — not just a flexible one.
  • You want to grow within a real global firm, not just take on another freelance gig.
  • Your written and spoken English is fluent.

Preferred Experience

  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online. Experience with NetSuite, Sage 300, Ramp, or Bill.com is a plus.
  • Experience in a professional services, outsourced accounting, or client-facing advisory environment.

Schedule, Onboarding & Engagement Structure

  • Working hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM PST (U.S. Pacific Time). Coverage during these hours is a core requirement of the role.
  • Onboarding: Onboarding is fully compensated and requires full availability from day one. Please indicate in your application whether you have any vacation or extended time off planned within the next 90 days.
  • Equipment: A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a headset are required from your start date.

What We Offer

  • 90-day structured onboarding with full compensation and paid training in U.S. GAAP and TGG processes.
  • Unlimited PTO after the onboarding period — we trust our people to manage their time responsibly, always ensuring client needs are covered.
  • IT equipment reimbursement to support your remote setup.
  • Maternity and paternity leave — because family comes first.
  • Health emergency support — we are here when life gets complicated.
  • Loyalty bonus for team members who reach 2+ years with us — we recognize and reward stability.
  • Ongoing support and follow-up from your team lead and HR — you are never left to figure things out alone.
  • Access to TGG University and continuous professional development.
  • Real career growth — we have a promotion system and performance review cycles that review each individual case. Many of our senior team members started exactly where you would.
  • A professional, multicultural team that holds itself to a high standard.

Important to know:

  • This is an Independent Contractor position, consistent with TGG's global model for our international professionals. After onboarding, compensation is based on hours worked (full-time or part-time depending on client allocation). Local holidays and sick leave apply from day one.

If you are looking for structure, growth, and a team that will challenge you to be better — we want to hear from you.

title: Banco de Talentos para Mulheres
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas alimentícias do mundo?

O Grupo Bimbo foi fundado no México no ano de 1945, e é líder mundial da indústria de panificação. Com um portfólio de mais de 100 marcas de prestígio, produzimos ao nível global mais de 10 mil tipos de produtos.

A Bimbo chegou ao Brasil em 2001 e, desde então, fazemos parte da família brasileira por meio das marcas: Pullman, Plus Vita, Ana Maria, Crocantissímo, Wickbold, Seven Boys e Rap10, fazendo a alegria de muitos lares brasileiros. Nossa visão é sermos uma empresa sustentável, altamente produtiva e plenamente humana. Atuamos também no mercado B2B fornecendo alimentos congelados a grandes redes varejistas, food services e QSR (Quick Service Restaurants ou Fast Food).

No Grupo Bimbo, a diversidade, equidade, inclusão e pertencimento são pilares fundamentais que orientam nossa cultura e nosso propósito de Alimentar um Mundo Melhor. Gerenciamos esses princípios por meio de uma estratégia que integra políticas globais, programas específicos e ações locais projetadas para refletir a diversidade demográfica das comunidades onde atuamos e que atendemos.

Nossa abordagem baseia-se na criação de ambientes inclusivos, onde cada pessoa pode ser autêntica e tem acesso a oportunidades para alcançar seu pleno potencial. Com compromisso constante, trabalhamos para promover a equidade em todas as nossas operações. Queremos garantir que a diversidade seja um impulsionador de inovação, crescimento e bem-estar, tanto dentro da nossa empresa quanto em nossas comunidades.

Se você é uma mulher que deseja fazer parte de uma empresa que cresce a cada dia e acredita no poder da inclusão e da diversidade, cadastre seu currículo em nosso Banco de Talentos para Mulheres e venha construir essa jornada com a gente!

title: Arquiteto Pleno
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida.

Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento.

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore; e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.

  • Responsável pelo Gerenciamento e Acompanhamento Remoto de Obras das franquias sob sua responsabilidade acompanhando cronograma, checagem de relatórios fotográficos e diários de obra para garantir a conformidade com o projeto aprovado.
  • Apoiar a equipe na identificação de riscos de atraso de obras e na proposição de planos de mitigação e orientar e apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico do Analista Júnior do núcleo no dia a dia da operação

title: Analista de Recrutamento & Seleção Jr. - Operações (Rolândia - PR)
description:
Na Dori | Ferrara, Ferrero, Fox's Burton's Companies e The Fine Biscuits Company, somos reconhecidos e amados por pessoas de todas as gerações pela alegria que compartilhamos com elas – uma alegria feita pelas nossas pessoas. Junte-se a nós e descubra um mundo cheio de possibilidades, onde sua paixão encontrará o seu lugar.

A Dori | Ferrara é uma das maiores empresas de doces e snacks do Brasil! Há mais de seis décadas, com um time de mais de 3000 colaboradores, produzimos produtos que acompanham gerações e fazem parte da história e das lembranças de milhões de famílias, com marcas icônicas como Gomets®, Yogurte 100®, Pettiz® e Disqueti®.

Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS®, Brach's®, Jelly Belly®, SweeTARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. E, na França, a Carambar & Co conquistou gerações de clientes fiéis graças ao apelo atemporal de marcas icônicas de doces e chocolates, como Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy e Terry's.

Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.

Sobre a vaga

Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção será responsável por apoiar e executar os processos de Recrutamento & Seleção das unidades fabris, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e aderência dos candidatos ao perfil das posições e à cultura da companhia. Atuar em parceria com gestores e áreas de Recursos Humanos das unidades, contribuindo para o atendimento das necessidades de contratação da operação e para uma experiência positiva dos candidatos ao longo do processo seletivo.

Localidade: Rolândia - PR

Reporta a: Gerente de Talent e Performance

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

Contamos com você para:

  • Conduzir processos de Recrutamento & Seleção para posições operacionais, técnicas e administrativas das unidades fabris, seguindo as políticas, procedimentos e SLAs estabelecidos pela área.
  • Realizar alinhamento de perfil das vagas com gestores e/ou RH das unidades, compreendendo requisitos técnicos, comportamentais e necessidades específicas da operação.
  • Divulgar oportunidades nos canais de recrutamento definidos pela companhia, buscando ampliar a atração de candidatos aderentes às posições.
  • Realizar triagem de currículos, entrevistas por competências e demais etapas previstas no processo seletivo.
  • Apoiar e conduzir processos seletivos de maior volume, especialmente para posições operacionais das fábricas.
  • Realizar busca ativa de candidatos e apoiar a construção de bancos de talentos para posições recorrentes e/ou críticas das unidades.
  • Manter contato próximo com candidatos durante todo o processo, garantindo comunicação adequada sobre etapas, prazos e devolutivas.
  • Acompanhar os processos desde a abertura da vaga até a aprovação do candidato e encaminhamento para admissão.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de recrutamento local, como feiras de empregabilidade, parcerias com instituições de ensino, entidades locais, comunidades e outros canais de atração.
  • Contribuir para ações de fortalecimento da marca empregadora nas regiões onde estão localizadas as unidades fabris.
  • Acompanhar indicadores básicos de R&S, como volume de vagas, tempo de fechamento, candidatos por vaga, fontes de recrutamento e status dos processos.
  • Atuar de forma integrada na condução do processo de integração.

Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia, Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência com recrutamento de alto volume para posições operacionais e industriais.
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes industriais, manufatura, logística ou centros de distribuição.

O que nós oferecemos:

Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:

  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Dr Dori (telemedicina)
  • Seguro de vida
  • Totalpass e/ou Wellhub
  • Refeitório no local
  • Cesta de Alimentos
  • Cesta de Natal
  • Vale transporte
  • Descontos em produtos

Igualdade de Oportunidades

Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e progressão de carreira. Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.

A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC ).

Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company's enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: StarRocks Expert Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
StarRocks Expert Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location: Remote (South & Central America, US Working Hours)

Department: Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering

Role Overview

As an Expert StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You'll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.

While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.

Requirements

  • 3+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs)
  • Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines.
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL.
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus: Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus: Contributions to open-source database projects.

About Deep. BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‐source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies. Our customers run mission‐critical, high‐volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We're a small, world-class expert, remote‐first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.

What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

Location & working style

  • Remote‐first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Administrative Specialist - Events and Facilities
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

About the Role

We are seeking an Administrative Specialist to support the management of administrative and facilities-related operations, ensuring efficient service delivery, effective vendor management, cost control, and a high-quality employee experience.

This role will act as an important operational partner for internal teams, coordinating administrative demands, supporting corporate events, managing vendor relationships, and monitoring budgets and service performance.

The professional will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to optimize processes, improve service quality, and increase operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Vendor Management

  • Support the management of the Administrative and Facilities vendor portfolio, including cleaning, transportation, catering, maintenance, accommodation, and corporate events.
  • Conduct quotations, analyze and compare proposals, and support contract negotiations to achieve the best cost-benefit relationship.
  • Monitor vendor SLAs, quality standards, and performance indicators, identifying deviations and supporting corrective actions when necessary.
  • Support contract renewals and renegotiations in partnership with the relevant subject-matter experts.
  • Maintain effective relationships with vendors and ensure alignment with company standards, operational requirements, and service expectations.

Internal Events

  • Support the planning and execution of internal company events, including onboarding programs, celebrations, training sessions, workshops, and other corporate initiatives.
  • Coordinate event logistics, including venues, catering, equipment, communications, and supporting vendors.
  • Manage event budgets, timelines, and operational requirements, ensuring activities are delivered according to plan.
  • Prepare supporting materials for events, including visual assets, communications, and operational documents.
  • Collect and analyze participant feedback and identify opportunities to continuously improve the employee experience.

Budget and Cost Management

  • Monitor monthly and annual budgets for the areas under management, in partnership with the respective specialists.
  • Track expenses and identify opportunities for cost reduction, resource optimization, and process efficiency.
  • Support the preparation of dashboards, reports, and management presentations to provide visibility into operational performance and costs.
  • Ensure administrative activities are aligned with approved budgets and financial guidelines.

Operational Support

  • Act as a key point of contact for internal client areas, understanding their needs and coordinating appropriate solutions.
  • Support continuous improvement projects within Facilities and Administrative Operations.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including HR, Finance, Labor Relations, Procurement, EHS, and other business areas, to ensure smooth execution of administrative initiatives.
  • Identify operational gaps and proactively propose solutions to improve service quality, efficiency, and employee experience.
  • Support the implementation and standardization of administrative processes and operational controls.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Facilities Management, Engineering, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in Facilities, Administrative Operations, Workplace Management, Vendor Management, or related areas.
  • Experience managing vendors, conducting quotations, supporting negotiations, and monitoring service performance.
  • Experience with budget tracking, cost control, and operational reporting.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with internal stakeholders, vendors, and employees at different organizational levels.
  • Advanced English proficiency in written and spoken communication is required, due to frequent interaction with expatriates and international stakeholders.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join Credix as a Sales Engineer. You will own the technical success of client integrations, from pre-sales feasibility to production go-live, ensuring fast activation and long-term integration stability.

Responsibilities

  • Technical pre-sales validation: Lead technical pre-sales by validating feasibility, defining integration scope, and identifying risks before commercial commitment.
  • Integration delivery and go-live readiness: Support sellers through implementation and testing, and act as the technical authority to approve or block go-live based on readiness criteria.
  • Post-go-live integration reliability: Ensure the ongoing health of live integrations by owning issue triage, resolution, or escalation within 24 business hours.
  • Feedback loop to Product and Engineering: Translate integration learnings into actionable feedback to improve platform reliability, scalability, and integration speed.
  • Align technical decisions with commercial outcomes: Partner closely with Sales and Account Managers to ensure integrations support activation, retention, and GMV growth.
  • Customer-facing engagement: Frequently travel to customer sites across Brazil to support integrations, technical alignment, and relationship building.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience working with REST APIs, including authentication, webhooks, error handling, and data modeling.
  • Prior exposure to complex system integrations, preferably in e-commerce platforms (e.g., VTEX) or ERPs.
  • Comfortable working with SQL to investigate integration behavior, validate data flows, and support issue triage using BI tools such as Hex or equivalent.
  • Able to use monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Kibana or equivalent) to identify, diagnose, and communicate production integration issues.
  • Able to produce clear, concise, and structured technical documentation for external partners and internal teams.
  • Organized, proactive, and reliable in driving integrations forward across multiple stakeholders.
  • Curious about customer contexts and constraints, while able to design pragmatic, repeatable integration solutions rather than one-off custom builds.
  • Prioritizes customer success while balancing platform scalability, reliability, and long-term architectural constraints.
  • Operates with high autonomy and ownership, demonstrating strong prioritization, self-direction, and accountability while executing against ambitious targets.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you'll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that's just the beginning - here's what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you're well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

qualificações

title: Senior PR & Communications Manager — Brazil
description:
About Anker Innovations

Anker Innovations is a global leader in consumer technology, home to beloved brands including Anker, eufy, soundcore, Nebula, and AnkerMake. Driven by the mission to "charge the possibilities through extreme innovation," we build products that millions of consumers love worldwide.

We're scaling our Latin America operations and are looking for a Senior PR & Communications Manager to build and lead Anker's communications function in Brazil.

About the Role

As Senior PR & Communications Manager, you'll own Anker's brand communications strategy for Brazil — shaping how we show up in media, with creators, and with consumers. Reporting to the regional marketing leader, you'll build the communications playbook from the ground up, lead a team, and be the trusted advisor on reputation, storytelling, and public affairs in the market.

Key Responsibilities

Communications Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and own the Brazil PR & communications strategy, aligned with regional business and global brand objectives
  • Build, mentor, and lead the communications team and agency network as the function scales

Media & Influencer Relations

  • Cultivate senior relationships across Brazilian tech, business, and lifestyle media (e.g., TecMundo, Canaltech, Olhar Digital, Exame, Valor, Folha)
  • Oversee media strategy, product reviews, and KOL/influencer programs at scale

Brand Storytelling & Campaigns

  • Lead integrated PR and communications campaigns for major product launches, brand moments, and partnerships
  • Partner with regional marketing and global communications to ensure consistent, locally resonant messaging

Corporate Communications & Reputation

  • Serve as the market's reputation lead, owning corporate communications, crisis/issues management, and public affairs
  • Advise leadership on communications implications of business decisions and regulatory/public sentiment

Performance & Governance

  • Establish KPIs, measurement, and reporting to demonstrate PR impact on awareness and brand equity
  • Manage the communications budget, agency selection, and vendor governance

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in PR, corporate communications, or agency leadership, with a track record of building brand reputation in Brazil
  • Native Portuguese with fluent business English (to align with regional and global leadership)
  • Deep media and KOL relationships across Brazilian tech, business, and consumer media
  • Proven ability to lead teams and agencies, manage budgets, and deliver at scale
  • Experience in crisis communications and issues management
  • Background in consumer electronics, technology, or lifestyle brands is strongly preferred
  • Excellent storytelling, presentation, and executive-communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience launching a brand or category in a new market
  • Public affairs / government relations exposure
  • Fluency in Spanish
  • Understanding of Brazil's retail and e-commerce media landscape

title: Analista de Planejamento Integrado
description:
Sobre a oportunidade:

Área: Planejamento Integrado

Atuação em: Matriz - São José/SC - Vaga temporária - até Julho de 2027

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial - de segunda a quinta das 07h30 às 17h30 e sexta-feira das 07h30 às 16h30.

No seu dia a dia você irá:

  • Conduzir o ciclo de Planejamento Integrado (S&OP), buscando o alinhamento entre oferta e demanda e garantindo um plano de suprimentos e produção viável;
  • Consolidar informações de vendas, carteira de pedidos, estoques, capacidade e parâmetros dos sistemas, mantendo relatórios e painéis de indicadores atualizados;
  • Elaborar previsões de demanda, incorporando informações de mercado, campanhas e lançamentos, além de contribuir para o consenso de demanda junto às áreas Comercial, Marketing e Produtos;
  • Elaborar o plano de suprimentos e o plano mestre de produção, avaliando capacidade, disponibilidade de materiais e níveis de estoque;
  • Realizar análises e simulações de cenários, identificando riscos e propondo alternativas para suportar a tomada de decisão;
  • Atuar na definição de políticas de estoque, como estoque de segurança e cobertura-alvo, além de apoiar a priorização de produtos;
  • Planejar a entrada e saída de linha de produtos, contribuindo para o controle de obsolescência;
  • Preparar e conduzir reuniões do ciclo de Planejamento Integrado, apresentando cenários, riscos e oportunidades e acompanhando os planos de ação;

title: Solutions PreSales Specialist | Data & AI
description:
A AI/R Company é um ecossistema global de tecnologia que reúne empresas especializadas em transformação digital, desenvolvimento de software, dados, inteligência artificial, cloud e plataformas de negócios. Atuamos com clientes de diferentes segmentos e portes, desenvolvendo soluções inovadoras que geram impacto real nos negócios.

Sobre a Posição

Você irá atuar como Solutions PreSales Specialist | Data & AI Sênior no Innovation Studio de Data & AI, sendo referência técnica e consultiva na construção de soluções que integram Engenharia de Dados, Governança de Dados e Analytics. Em parceria com clientes, parceiros tecnológicos, times comerciais, engenharia e delivery, você irá traduzir desafios de negócio em arquiteturas viáveis e economicamente sustentáveis, apoiando oportunidades complexas de construção e modernização de plataformas, migrações entre tecnologias e clouds e evolução de ecossistemas analíticos corporativos.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Atuar como referência técnica sênior em plataformas de dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de pré-venda;
  • Conduzir workshops de discovery e assessments, identificando desafios de negócio, requisitos técnicos e maturidade do ecossistema de dados dos clientes;
  • Desenhar e apresentar soluções baseadas em Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh e Data Warehouse moderno, contemplando processamento batch e streaming;
  • Estruturar soluções de ingestão, processamento, transformação e modelagem de dados, utilizando tecnologias como Databricks, Snowflake, serviços AWS, Spark, Airflow, dbt e Kafka;
  • Incorporar às arquiteturas aspectos de qualidade, catálogo, linhagem, segurança, privacidade e conformidade dos dados;
  • Garantir que as soluções propostas atendam às necessidades de consumo analítico e habilitação de casos de uso de inteligência artificial;
  • Elaborar propostas técnicas, estimativas, roadmaps de modernização e business cases, equilibrando escopo, custos, riscos e valor para o negócio;
  • Conduzir apresentações executivas, defesas técnicas e provas de conceito (PoCs) com clientes e parceiros;
  • Apoiar respostas a RFPs e RFIs, realizando análise de requisitos, definição de escopo e detalhamento das soluções;
  • Colaborar com os times comerciais, de engenharia e delivery para assegurar a viabilidade das propostas e o alinhamento entre a solução vendida e sua execução;
  • Contribuir para a evolução do portfólio de ofertas, frameworks e aceleradores do Studio, em alinhamento com parceiros estratégicos e com a estratégia de inovação da companhia.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em pré-venda técnica, arquitetura de soluções ou consultoria em plataformas de dados, com participação em oportunidades de alta complexidade;
  • Visão integrada dos pilares de Engenharia de Dados, Governança de Dados e Analytics;
  • Experiência no desenho de arquiteturas modernas de dados, com conhecimento em Data Lakehouse, Data Warehouse moderno e princípios de Data Mesh;
  • Conhecimento em integração, ingestão, processamento e modelagem de dados, incluindo pipelines batch e streaming;
  • Experiência com plataformas como Databricks e/ou Snowflake e conhecimento em serviços AWS aplicados a dados, como S3, Glue, Redshift e Lake Formation;
  • Familiaridade com tecnologias como Spark, Airflow, dbt e Kafka, compreendendo suas aplicações e critérios de escolha;
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados, incluindo qualidade, catálogo, linhagem, controle de acesso, segurança, privacidade e conformidade;
  • Vivência em projetos de modernização de plataformas e migração de dados entre tecnologias e ambientes cloud;
  • Experiência na elaboração de propostas técnicas, estimativas de esforço e custos, definição de escopo e roadmaps;
  • Capacidade de avaliar viabilidade técnica e econômica, explicitando premissas, riscos e decisões de arquitetura;
  • Habilidade para conduzir discussões técnicas e executivas, traduzindo conceitos complexos em soluções conectadas às necessidades do negócio;
  • Perfil consultivo, analítico e colaborativo, com autonomia e organização para atuar em múltiplas oportunidades.

Desejável:

  • Certificações em Databricks, Snowflake, AWS ou tecnologias correlatas;
  • Experiência em ambientes multicloud e projetos de migração entre provedores;
  • Vivência na condução de PoCs, respostas a RFPs/RFIs e defesas técnicas;
  • Experiência na estruturação de business cases e análises de custo total de propriedade (TCO);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI, visualização de dados e camadas semânticas;
  • Experiência com plataformas de dados que sustentem casos de uso de inteligência artificial;
  • Atuação na criação de ofertas, frameworks, arquiteturas de referência ou aceleradores reutilizáveis.

title: Senior Product Designer - Data & Analytics
description:
Atividades:

Sobre a posição:

Buscamos um(a) Senior Product Designer – Data & Analytics para atuar em uma frente Comercial, entendendo profundamente a rotina dos usuários e transformando necessidades reais em produtos e experiências orientados por dados. A posição terá forte atuação em Product Discovery e UX Research, acompanhando usuários em campo, mapeando jornadas, investigando dores e identificando como dados, indicadores, alertas e recomendações podem apoiar melhores decisões no dia a dia.

Mais do que desenhar interfaces, buscamos uma pessoa interessada em entender o problema antes de desenhar a solução, trabalhando em parceria com os times de Dados & Analytics e Tecnologia para transformar descobertas em produtos simples, úteis e acionáveis.

  • Validar hipóteses e soluções diretamente com os usuários;

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Analytics, Desenvolvimento e demais integrantes das squads;
  • Acompanhar as soluções após a implementação, avaliando adoção, experiência e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Contribuir para a construção de produtos orientados por dados e centrados nas necessidades reais dos usuários.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sênior em Product Design;
  • Forte experiência com UX Research e Product Discovery;
  • Vivência com entrevistas, pesquisa com usuários, testes e validação de hipóteses;
  • Experiência com mapeamento de jornadas e identificação de necessidades;
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de pesquisa qualitativa e observação de usuários;
  • Experiência com criação de wireframes, fluxos e protótipos;
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em experiências simples e acionáveis;
  • Perfil hands-on e facilidade para trabalhar próximo aos usuários;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação com diferentes áreas e especialidades;
  • Disponibilidade para acompanhar vendedores e clientes em atividades de campo.

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com força de vendas e jornada comercial;
  • Vivência em ambientes B2B;
  • Experiência com produtos de Dados & Analytics;
  • Experiência com produtos que utilizem indicadores, recomendações ou insights para apoiar decisões dos usuários;
  • Vivência em squads multidisciplinares de Produto, Dados e Tecnologia.

Local de atuação: São Paulo (Amparo)/SP

Modelo de trabalho: híbrido, com atuação presencial 3 vezes por semana, além de atividades de campo relacionadas às pesquisas com usuários

Modelo de contratação: temporário

Se você acredita que bons produtos começam pela compreensão profunda do usuário e gosta de transformar descobertas em experiências que geram impacto real, queremos conhecer você.

title: Coordenador de Crédito e Cobrança
description:
A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 158 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.

A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além. Fazer parte da empresa significa integrar uma equipe que valoriza dedicação, trabalho em equipe e desenvolvimento profissional, oferecendo suporte e ferramentas para o crescimento e construção de carreira dos AutoZoners.

Descrição do Cargo

Responsável por coordenar as atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento e cobrança, garantindo a eficiência dos processos, a mitigação de riscos e o cumprimento dos prazos e políticas internas. Atua de forma estratégica na gestão da carteira de clientes, apoiando o negócio na tomada de decisão e assegurando a saúde financeira das operações.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de crédito: Coordenar a análise e concessão de crédito, garantindo aderência às políticas internas e adequada avaliação de risco, com base em relatórios financeiros, histórico de pagamento e informações de mercado.
  • Gestão da cobrança: Liderar as estratégias de cobrança, acompanhando indicadores de inadimplência, definindo ações para recuperação de crédito e conduzindo negociações em casos mais críticos.
  • Gestão de equipe: Liderar, desenvolver e acompanhar a equipe, promovendo alinhamento de metas, capacitação e melhoria contínua dos processos da área.
  • Controle e governança: Assegurar a acuracidade dos registros de contas a receber, bem como a conformidade com os controles internos, políticas corporativas e exigências de auditoria.
  • Indicadores e performance: Monitorar KPIs da área, elaborando relatórios gerenciais e propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Interface com áreas internas: Atuar de forma próxima às áreas comerciais, operações (lojas), financeiras e demais stakeholders, garantindo alinhamento estratégico e suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Melhoria de processos: Identificar oportunidades de otimização e automação dos processos de crédito e cobrança, promovendo eficiência e redução de riscos.

Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo (Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas).
  • Vivência na área de crédito ou cobrança.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Diferencial: Conhecimento com ERP SAP ou TOTVS Protheus.

Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido, com atuação na região da Vila Leopoldina.
  • Benefícios oferecidos: assistência médica, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio com academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e 20% de desconto em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

title: Consultor Técnico Jr Química/Industrial

description:

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Accountant / Full-Charge Bookkeeper (2 Openings)

Full-Time, 40 hrs/week | PST-overlap schedule (South America afternoon hours) | Long-Term Contract & Remote

About the Role

A U.S.-based business management and accounting firm serving clients in the entertainment industry is looking for two experienced accounting professionals to join their remote team. Both roles handle full-charge bookkeeping and day-to-day accounting operations end-to-end; one of the two positions carries an additional focus on U.S. tax preparation. This is a high-ownership role for someone who already understands accounting fundamentals and can operate independently in a fast-paced professional services environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle full-charge bookkeeping from transaction entry through financial reporting
  • Record and categorize financial transactions accurately in accordance with U.S. GAAP
  • Perform bank and account reconciliations
  • Manage accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR)
  • Process and support payroll activities
  • Prepare and maintain financial statements and accounting records
  • Assist with financial analysis and account review
  • Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up on open account issues
  • Support client bill payment and accounting-related business management activities
  • Work primarily in QuickBooks and the firm's internal workflow systems, including TaxDome
  • Follow established internal procedures while proactively communicating discrepancies, unusual transactions, or client issues to management

Requirements

Both Positions

  • 3+ years of relevant accounting or full-charge bookkeeping experience preferred; demonstrated depth of competency matters more than years alone
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP
  • Hands-on experience with: bank reconciliations, AP, AR, payroll, and financial statement preparation
  • Strong QuickBooks proficiency (daily operational use)
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable managing multiple client accounts in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal English communication; proactive about flagging issues
  • Experience with U.S.-based companies or accounting firms is a strong plus
  • TaxDome experience is a plus
  • CPA designation is not required

Position 2 — Additional Requirements (Tax Preparation Focus)

  • Hands-on experience preparing U.S. tax returns
  • Working knowledge of U.S. taxation and basic IRS requirements
  • Experience supporting a U.S. CPA, tax practice, or accounting firm strongly preferred
  • Enrolled Agent (EA) designation is a plus but not required
  • Must be prepared to deepen tax knowledge under the firm's direct guidance

Ideal Candidate

You already understand accounting fundamentals and don't need to be trained on the basics — you can independently handle a bank reconciliation, manage AP/AR, and produce clean financial statements without step-by-step guidance. You're sharp, self-directed, and you flag problems before they escalate rather than waiting to be asked. You take real ownership of accuracy in your work and are comfortable serving multiple clients in a fast-moving environment. For Position 2, you bring practical exposure to U.S. tax return preparation and are ready to build on that foundation under the firm's coaching.

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
About the Company

Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.

Company Website:

About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors

Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.

We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

Compensation & Benefits

This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.

Why Join Us

Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you've ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: In-Store Artist
description:
Golden Goose is a journey of love and authenticity, leading you to embrace your true self, where tradition and innovation merge into timeless, one-of-a-kind creations.

The candidate will join the store team located in Sao Paulo Iguatemi JK.

The Sneaker Maker / In-Store Artist role is centred around Co-creation services transforming Golden Goose items into distinctive pieces that resonate with client needs and identity.   • Fluency in local language. Additional language knowledge will be considered as a plus, reflecting our commitment to a diverse and inclusive workforce;

  • Availability to work varied hours and days including nights, weekends and holidays as needed;

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago

title: PESSOA BIBLIOTECÁRIA - OSASCO/SP
description:

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

MODELO DE TRABALHO PRESENCIAL.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

description:

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B" e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de Linhares - ES

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Especialista em Governança e Saneamento de Dados Mestres
description:
A akquinet Brasil está buscando um(a) Especialista em Governança e Saneamento de Dados Mestres para fazer parte da nossa equipe

Se você possui experiência com cadastro de materiais, qualidade de dados, classificação técnica, taxonomias, governança de dados mestres e busca constantemente formas de utilizar Inteligência Artificial para otimizar processos, essa oportunidade pode ser para você!

O profissional atuará em projetos de Master Data Management (MDM), apoiando iniciativas de saneamento, classificação, padronização e governança de dados mestres para clientes de diferentes segmentos.

Além da execução dos projetos, será responsável pela evolução da metodologia de saneamento da empresa, definição de padrões, indicadores de qualidade, boas práticas e utilização de Inteligência Artificial aplicada à Governança de Dados.

Buscamos alguém com perfil analítico e liderança técnica, capaz de estruturar processos, definir padrões corporativos, capacitar a equipe e atuar como referência interna em Governança e Saneamento de Dados Mestres.

Principais atividades:

  • Estruturar e evoluir a metodologia de saneamento de materiais da empresa;
  • Executar projetos de saneamento, classificação, enriquecimento e governança de dados mestres para clientes de diferentes segmentos;
  • Criar, revisar e manter PDMs (Padrões Descritivos de Materiais), taxonomias, categorias, classes, atributos e regras de catalogação;
  • Estruturar descrições padronizadas, padrões corporativos e processos de governança de dados;
  • Interpretar catálogos de fabricantes, fichas técnicas, desenhos, normas e demais documentações técnicas;
  • Definir padrões, indicadores (KPIs) e ações de melhoria contínua para qualidade e consistência dos dados mestres;
  • Participar da definição, evolução e utilização de soluções de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à classificação, enriquecimento, governança e saneamento de dados mestres;
  • Apoiar clientes e áreas de negócio na definição de padrões corporativos para materiais;
  • Atuar como referência técnica em iniciativas de Governança de Dados, MDM e gestão de catálogos, apoiando a capacitação e evolução da equipe.

Requisitos básicos:

  • Experiência comprovada com saneamento, catalogação ou gestão de dados mestres;
  • Experiência com materiais em sistemas ERP;
  • Experiência com processos ou ferramentas de Master Data Management (MDM) e Governança de Dados Mestres (MDG);
  • Experiência na criação, revisão e manutenção de PDMs (Padrões Descritivos de Materiais);
  • Conhecimento em taxonomias, classificação, catalogação e especificações técnicas de materiais;
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica, desenhos, catálogos e fichas de fabricantes;
  • Experiência com materiais industriais, MRO, manutenção, suprimentos ou engenharia;
  • Conhecimento em qualidade e governança de dados;
  • Facilidade para análise de grandes volumes de informações e identificação de padrões;
  • Conhecimento em Excel ou ferramentas similares de análise e qualidade de dados.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos de saneamento de materiais em larga escala;
  • Experiência na estruturação de processos e metodologias de governança de dados mestres;
  • Conhecimento em taxonomias como UNSPSC, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em classificação fiscal (NCM);
  • Conhecimento em normas ABNT, ASTM, DIN, ISO, ANSI, ASME ou equivalentes;
  • Experiência com Power BI;
  • Experiência na utilização de Inteligência Artificial aplicada à classificação e saneamento de dados mestres;
  • Conhecimento ou experiência em SAP ECC e SAP S/4HANA;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado para leitura e pesquisa técnica.

Soft skills:

  • Atenção aos detalhes;
  • Pensamento analítico;
  • Comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Organização e gestão do tempo;
  • Autonomia, proatividade e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e resolver problemas.

Oferecemos:

  • Salário compatível com a função;
  • Muitas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Participação em projetos inovadores envolvendo Inteligência Artificial, MDM e Governança de Dados;
  • Ambiente de trabalho diferenciado;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Trabalho híbrido (após adaptação inicial);
